To: Friend | dpwillis67@gmail.com From: Team Cassidy Date: 10/05/2023
Friend,
As the Biden Administration continues to press forward with its unconstitutional student loan “forgiveness” initiative, we felt it was time to set the record straight.
_To be clear:_ Biden’s income-driven repayment plan doesn’t “forgive” anything – it merely shifts the burden of******more than $550 BILLION in student loan debt****** away from the borrowers and onto the nearly 90% of Americans who don’t have student loans.
Senator Cassidy recently published an op-ed in the Washington Examiner titled, “A better solution to the student loan crisis” outlining his thoughts in more detail, including an alternative proposal to address the student loan crisis and skyrocketing costs of higher education.

CASSIDY’S OP-ED “A BETTER SOLUTION TO THE STUDENT LOAN CRISIS” To: Friend | dpwillis67@gmail.com From: Team Cassidy Date: 10/05/2023 Friend, As the Biden Administration continues to press forward with its unconstitutional student loan “forgiveness” initiative, we felt it was time to set the record straight. To be clear: Biden’s income-driven repayment plan doesn’t “forgive” anything – it merely shifts the burden of****more than $550 BILLION in student loan debt**** away from the borrowers and onto the nearly 90% of Americans who don’t have student loans. Senator Cassidy recently published an op-ed in the Washington Examiner titled, “A better solution to the student loan crisis” outlining his thoughts in more detail, including an alternative proposal to address the student loan crisis and skyrocketing costs of higher education. | As always, thank you for your continued support. | Hi, it’s Jane Fonda.

For decades, universities across the United States have heavily invested in the fossil fuel industry using taxpayer money and tuition payments. I have seen firsthand over the past few years how passionate and involved young people, including students in universities and colleges across the country, are in the fight against the climate crisis.

And yet, while thousands of students continue to demand climate action, they are forced to prop up the fossil fuel industry because their universities’ leadership control how their money is invested.

Now, college students and young people are demanding universities and colleges to divest from the fossil fuel industry and take action to address climate change. [_**Will you join me in supporting them by signing our petition?**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/71066517/431047405/697297779?source=direct_link&referrer=group-jfcp-woa&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjY2ZGFjMDk1LWRmNjMtZWUxMS05OTM3LTAwMjI0ODMyZWI3MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=1VMADgox4u0uw52rb7Xro6DG-HXcYYRVrPqSSeCaIYw=&emci=62dac095-df63-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&emdi=66dac095-df63-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&ceid=4823105)

Peter, Saturday was our first End-of-Quarter fundraising deadline since I announced I’m challenging MAGA Republican David Schweikert for his seat in Congress and I’m excited to share that we surpassed our goal!

Truly every gift matters, because the stakes are high. Arizonans are tired of Schweikert’s extremism; we’re fed up with how he’s voted against our best interests over and over again, including just last week when he voted to close the government.

I’m running because I want to use my economic expertise to help clean up Washington and make sure Congress is working — not just for the elite 1% — but for all Arizona families.

There’s a lot on the line, Peter. _**Get to Know Ron DeSantis**_
---
| | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zegh934dajrhullq93bvfhp52stbug9jlc0s1cuo_rp22sh2s8i66p73clge4o72cth2bs)
---

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is _personal_ and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

---
| [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z7ipn6vmbu0uugtd2l6c3ljvmsfn8goci8qf8oh0_rp22sh2s8i66p73clge4o72cth2bs)
---

On Day One, Ron DeSantis has _promised_ that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by _immediately getting to work_ stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late. In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon. _That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now._

---
My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zaeul1s2956p2rsf19sv33frkea8cg4acuqki0g0_rp22sh2s8i66p73clge6ob1cph2bs "Will you join me today and help me save our country?")**

body:
Friend, you need to know this man.

| |
---
| | | Friend,

Today, we wanted to talk to you about an extraordinary man who embodies the qualities we need in a leader - Dave McCormick.

He's running for Senate in Pennsylvania, and the outcome of his race will determine whether Republicans take back the upper chamber or continue losing to Democrats' majority.
---
| | [HELP DAVE WIN](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zm571md2cd78fk07043hhlgls8j8kea9a4io1mm8_)
---
Dave's journey began in a small town in Pennsylvania, where he was raised by two hard-working teachers. His childhood was marked by the simple pleasures of winter deer hunting, and summers spent trimming Christmas trees on the family farm. But high school wrestling ignited a spark in Dave, a passion that would shape his path in ways he never imagined.

Wrestling opened doors to opportunities that seemed out of reach. It led Dave to West Point, where he pursued his love for the sport and embarked on a lifelong commitment to serve our nation. His relentless dedication and unwavering spirit propelled him through the ranks, eventually earning him the honor of becoming a paratrooper and a 2nd Lieutenant.

However, Dave's journey took an unexpected turn when he received orders to deploy to the Gulf War as part of Operation Desert Storm. The secrecy and chaos surrounding their mission meant they couldn't say goodbye to their families, and communication was limited to handwritten letters. Dave wrote to his parents as often as he could, with his mother cherishing those letters in a box at home.

Just before Christmas, a massive box arrived at their desert camp. To Dave and his fellow soldiers' astonishment, it contained a Christmas tree personally selected by Dave's father from their family farm. In the Saudi desert, thousands of miles away from home, Dave and his fellow soldiers experienced a fleeting moment of Christmas joy and a profound reminder of their roots. Even the most battle-hardened soldiers couldn't help but smile at this unexpected blessing.

_This story embodies Dave 's character, dedication to our country, and his vision for a brighter America. It's a story that speaks to the core of who Dave is and what motivates him to serve. _

**[Our nation is at a critical crossroads, and we need strong conservative leaders who will stand and fiercely defend the values that make America great. We need leaders like Dave McCormick.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zqo3m2t7cgqcuq5tpognd3h2vpjgd7sbv15s4jdg_ "Our nation is at a critical crossroads, and we need strong conservative leaders who will stand and fiercely defend the values that make America great. We need leaders like Dave McCormick.")**

By supporting Dave, you're backing a true leader with a unique blend of military experience, business acumen, and an unwavering dedication to serving our great nation.

He's running for Senate in Pennsylvania, and the outcome of his race will determine whether Republicans take back the upper chamber or continue losing to Democrats' majority. | | Dave's journey began in a small town in Pennsylvania, where he was raised by two hard-working teachers. His childhood was marked by the simple pleasures of winter deer hunting, and summers spent trimming Christmas trees on the family farm. But high school wrestling ignited a spark in Dave, a passion that would shape his path in ways he never imagined. Wrestling opened doors to opportunities that seemed out of reach. It led Dave to West Point, where he pursued his love for the sport and embarked on a lifelong commitment to serve our nation. His relentless dedication and unwavering spirit propelled him through the ranks, eventually earning him the honor of becoming a paratrooper and a 2nd Lieutenant. However, Dave's journey took an unexpected turn when he received orders to deploy to the Gulf War as part of Operation Desert Storm. The secrecy and chaos surrounding their mission meant they couldn't say goodbye to their families, and communication was limited to handwritten letters. Dave wrote to his parents as often as he could, with his mother cherishing those letters in a box at home. Just before Christmas, a massive box arrived at their desert camp. To Dave and his fellow soldiers' astonishment, it contained a Christmas tree personally selected by Dave's father from their family farm. In the Saudi desert, thousands of miles away from home, Dave and his fellow soldiers experienced a fleeting moment of Christmas joy and a profound reminder of their roots. My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m running for President of the United States.

I’m running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I’m running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I’m running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I’m doing this for my son who’s a senior in college and shouldn’t have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn’t believe in just to get an A.

I’m running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I’m running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I’ve seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden’s leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a “jobs governor”** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I’ve done it before. **And I’ll do it as your next President. **

As President, I’ll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington’s spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America’s future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c24773%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=3MFuspaJ%2bmTGbHLJBIyZWg&sysid=1 "Will you join me today and
help me save our country?")**

body:
Ron DeSantis wants to make sure you understand why your support is so critical to this campaign.

---
| | | | | | | | | | [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z9a8uoieso06md3adcc7k3cpb3aphpd9tukb5u2o_rp22sh2s8i66p73clieeoj4c9h2bs)
---

Friend, Our fundraising team is run differently here. When we send out emails and texts asking for your support, it is not because we want to put even more strain on your finances under Biden's disastrous economy; it's because we're _honest_ with our team about where we're at with our fundraising numbers and what more we need to push our momentum as far as we can. **_We've reached the point in the campaign of our 100-day critical stretch to the Iowa Caucus on January 15th_** _._ To give perspective _,_**_[if each person who read this email on our distribution list chipped in at least $47](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z1k301hrrcgg8b32egfj3e8k6nue49vahtm28pr8_rp22sh2s8i66p73clieeoj4c9h2bs "if each person who read this email on our distribution list chipped in at least $47")_** _**,** __we'd have enough resources to travel across the Hawkeye State and hand out yard signs, earn support, and reach voters in every county --and we wouldn't need to send another fundraising email until the Caucus.._
---
| | [Help Ron DeSantis hit his goal >> Chip in $47](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zuv1roe7r2a0j2t419krajt5evq93kfqmrhpig50_rp22sh2s8i66p73clieeoj4c9h2bs)
---
Today, it's our mission to make sure you understand why this milestone matters and how critical it is to our campaign.
---
| | | _We cannot allow our support to dwindle when there is this much on the line._ **_[Our team knows we're asking for a lot, but can we count on your support before we begin our critical 100-day stretch?](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zmsjd8nbv95lvf61an9r2runeen76qsf2h4tds5g_rp22sh2s8i66p73clieeoj4c9h2bs "Our team knows we're asking for a lot, but can we count on your support before the end-of-quarter deadline on Saturday?")_**
---
| | | | [DONATE TODAY](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z61d39b8vtpr06plk9r8svq02md4fbgs05jd3fj0_rp22sh2s8i66p73clieeoj4c9h2bs)
---
We're depending on you, friend. We have a deadline, we have a goal, and we have to hit it. Every single donation makes a difference to this campaign, and every single donor has a special spot on this team. Before the stretch begins tomorrow, please, donate any amount you can: **[https://RonDeSantis.com/donate-today](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zdletchlrsq7l7f8fs40ouuat9vvg84uaisdq520_rp22sh2s8i66p73clieeoj4c9h2bs "https://RonDeSantis.com/donate-today")**. _Winning the Iowa Caucus means setting the tone for the next phase of our Great American Comeback and proving to the country that Americans across the country are standing up because they_** _believe_** _freedom is worth fighting for._
---

Ron DeSantis

_**Get to Know Ron DeSantis**_
---
| | | [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zfjfou5bbbvm9niclkbqu0ot0sgje33q23l0lvc8_rp22sh2s8i66p73clieeoj4c9h2bs)
---

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is _personal_ and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

---
| [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zeag7h8cdtounj3gghu4cl5jgch2863h6sfdbbs8_rp22sh2s8i66p73clieeoj4c9h2bs)
---

On Day One, Ron DeSantis has _promised_ that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by _immediately getting to work_ stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late. In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon. _That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now._

body:
Friend, you need to know this man.

| |
---
| | | Friend,

Today, we wanted to talk to you about an extraordinary man who embodies the qualities we need in a leader - Dave McCormick.

He’s running for Senate in Pennsylvania, and the outcome of his race will determine whether Republicans take back the upper chamber or continue losing to Democrats’ majority.
---
| | [HELP DAVE WIN](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c24790%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=WEHANNSKj2ypU8BQ2yJvBA&sysid=1)
---
Dave's journey began in a small town in Pennsylvania, where he was raised by two hard-working teachers. His childhood was marked by the simple pleasures of winter deer hunting, and summers spent trimming Christmas trees on the family farm. But high school wrestling ignited a spark in Dave, a passion that would shape his path in ways he never imagined.

Wrestling opened doors to opportunities that seemed out of reach. It led Dave to West Point, where he pursued his love for the sport and embarked on a lifelong commitment to serve our nation. His relentless dedication and unwavering spirit propelled him through the ranks, eventually earning him the honor of becoming a paratrooper and a 2nd Lieutenant.

However, Dave's journey took an unexpected turn when he received orders to deploy to the Gulf War as part of Operation Desert Storm. The secrecy and chaos surrounding their mission meant they couldn't say goodbye to their families, and communication was limited to handwritten letters. Dave wrote to his parents as often as he could, with his mother cherishing those letters in a box at home.

Just before Christmas, a massive box arrived at their desert camp. To Dave and his fellow soldiers’ astonishment, it contained a Christmas tree personally selected by Dave's father from their family farm. In the Saudi desert, thousands of miles away from home, Dave and his fellow soldiers experienced a fleeting moment of Christmas joy and a profound reminder of their roots. Even the most battle-hardened soldiers couldn't help but smile at this unexpected blessing.

_This story embodies Dave’s character, dedication to our country, and his vision for a brighter America. It's a story that speaks to the core of who Dave is and what motivates him to serve. _

**[Our nation is at a critical crossroads, and we need strong conservative leaders who will stand and fiercely defend the values that make America great. We need leaders like Dave McCormick.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c24791%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=FqLMLIFgI4G5wmWsxExntQ&sysid=1 "Our nation is at a
critical crossroads, and we need strong conservative leaders who will stand and
fiercely defend the values that make America great. We need leaders like Dave
McCormick.")**
---
| | [HELP DAVE WIN](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c24790%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=WEHANNSKj2ypU8BQ2yJvBA&sysid=1)
---
**We’re looking for a few strong conservatives to help kickstart American Renewal. **

By supporting Dave, you're backing a true leader with a unique blend of military experience, business acumen, and an unwavering dedication to serving our great nation.

_**[If conservatives stand together, we can turn the country around and renew America. But this is easier said than done, Friend. That’s why we need you on our team!](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c24792%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=DhJiVGHrSvSwJJpAD12B3w&sysid=1 "If conservatives stand together, we can turn
the country around and renew America. But this is easier said than done, Friend.

---
Together, we can empower Dave McCormick to be a powerful voice in the U.S. Senate, fighting for conservative principles and ensuring our voices are heard.

We encourage you to share this message with your friends, family, and fellow conservatives who share our passion for a stronger, more prosperous America.

_**[Your dedication to renewing America's strength is deeply appreciated, and your support is invaluable as Republicans work to take back the Senate and save our country.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c24794%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=sBmrCaeVywmbYj4pqdLfxw&sysid=1 "Your dedication to renewing America's

name: LTC(R) Christian Castelli
subject: Let’s complete the mission!
body:
Peter,

October is off to a frenzied start, and we are less than a week in.

* Kevin McCarthy was removed as Speaker.
* Next week, the U.S. House will choose a new direction and new Speaker of the House.
* However, Congress and the people's business is on pause until then.

I'm Christian Castelli. Green Beret. 22-year combat veteran. And a God-fearing, experienced and tested conservative.

I've seen my share of conflict and chaos. I don't shy away from challenges. I see the mission through to the end.

Will you join me and finish the mission?

[****](https://secure.winred.com/committee-to-elect-christian-castelli/donate-today)

Republicans need to put aside their differences and do what's right.

* We need to pass single focus spending bills.
* We need to have an immediate up or down vote on border security.
* We need to recommit to passing a Balanced Budget Amendment.

As a God-fearing, experienced, and tested conservative, I will not stop until the mission is complete and won.

Join me and let's complete the mission. Please donate $250, $100, $50, or even $25 today.

**[](https://secure.winred.com/committee-to-elect-christian-castelli/donate-today)**

R. Christian Castelli

## Biden Resumes Building Trump's Border Wall
The Biden administration waived 26 federal laws [to allow construction to resume](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO6yAQAL_G7ohgwThbULwmXV57pbWGtbMnbCKM4ru_P-XqK0fTjObjPt1Jsuzrf9o4tKVMFJu8eDJaeQV2gj6FhRnY9hyMRz-gs9r3j8ADRyQAHMnN8QqR9cAMpLXVTPHaSwAN1mjtNQ4DwAXt4k28mrjEAQFj5zQnaaVePovs7cFL_i4vrpdYtj6HR2vPo7P_Orh1cKPnzufxVm-oTWLmDm5zqYmrOilnNUviXcm2yVqpSdlV4y86VJWi1kp7YmXcmEaaHY7sEQ0jEwKCgwVM5Bn6GtLzlJzl8GPn9LqR5N-e9uednwAAAP__uudlyA) on the South Texas border wall championed by former President Donald Trump. Biden campaigned against the wall, but his administration now says there's an urgent need for "physical barriers." Biden waived the Clean Air Act, the Safe Drinking Water Act, and the Endangered Species Act, among others, to allow the Department of Homeland Security to begin construction on an additional 20 miles of wall. Facing criticism for the move, Biden said he didn't like it but that his hands were tied because the money was earmarked specifically for the wall. [Trump scoffed](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO4yAUAL8GOiJ42MQUFNe4y7VXWhge4Z3ARJgk2r9fZeutR5qR5t9tu3kqdNz_-opupLb5MOiFm5LCCNAb8OgSIqDm6JSxZraTloZnZ7WExaBfFo_qiklOekn7lKzSwV615-RAglZSGmnnGeBidTIqLCqkMFuwgU0SI43WL_8bHSNjKl_thf0SWuXF5TEeJ9N_GKwM1pExUykfxmDNreKB75PB6mOlg87R_aB2MFgn0NZYKUZ_1ocImSKeYqeIh_jYRW0vFKOJ_Uklir31iF28fSkMVt5dfLypFDrNlU3yXj39NPn49c53AAAA__9lSGbc) on social media. "I will await his apology," he posted.
## Supermarket Chicken Prices Soar to New High
Chicken prices at U.S. grocery stores [have hit record highs](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFyqzAQheGnEZ0YaUGyKShuQ-fbpmSQtDKbACJaYcZ5-oxdpz2n-eb_uI23iRba7v-nFfsS0zj5Qg8ctZJWQjNCFfqICNhU2GvbWdO1jbLV3OvOqcZdQJvWaKVMcBCsv4bJOq2jcxX1oKDRSlnVGQNQd0202l-1j9500HnRKgxUUq4_E21lxrg80wNz7dNaLf1cys6i-SdgEDCc51lnPApmfv0CBncwbcgsYMhYJlqkTxsfK-b34lMO0s_kv3CTeyaPLPn7QPxBebDkOe07ZpYON4xUZHly2mRMKbB8waVWUhkBQ5X7sJ-0LMT2Ilp1Xyda3sbyZ7HfAAAA__9t9W5z) and will likely stay high as Tyson Foods and other poultry companies cut back on production. Consumers have been buying more chicken as inflation makes beef and pork increasingly expensive. American consumption of chicken is expected t[o exceed 100 pounds per person](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGSpCAUAL9GMyxEYYaA4BKzufRCCx-P4Z0IFjDj3d9v7W66YVd10NV_HuvDUqT0_G0PNM3n1UKjN64jZ4qJaRW9Mx5R4NSjGZVWUs8TV30wN4sOpHNiVoCS3_UN_Oi95PcN-ehdT0ZwMY2cK66lFGLQk1cj3EfwILXQ0M0cHbVchr-ZUgvo4__8xjJAPvpoQmtn7aZfnVg6sVzXNfj8b3tVSljrp9OJ5bBlx1Y7sUAg2DGxsxBgZYEaKwi5OBboGSrbyGFi1h2UqLZiG-XEXpVR8vEbdsSTbYienbnsrKCF0BfjzotipKpu3cyfh6X41dd-vPURAAD__yERcCo) this year for the first time ever. Beef consumption is forecast to drop to its lowest level since 2018, and pork consumption is at its lowest since 2015. The issue of food inflation has been spiking on social media, with many consumers arguing that prices have risen far more than government figures indicate, as [this video from a shopper](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DFr8zAQgOFfI28JpzvrHA0aPgheQgIfhBS6GFWWExU5CtY1Jv--0K6d3-XleTsOR59yul9Pfo5OpjL4IOkZBw0b3iAN2IxuihEjNdFptmxsS8DNzYUwYouGOzCj99Yb6-1kOaAJHekP0ySHgKQBGKwxiFtLE-uw02EKxqINqoU4JinL9rOku9zilF_lGZdtKHOT3U3kURX9U9gr7GVNIr9NYb_6nKssMUpN-amwr-LlqyrsdQeWAVi3mjTtAAkU9VXRvmWFLIr2M15O58O8yutSzry-Hzjs7_-bxY2PNeWcKneqhevsU_5ZkT9hvgMAAP__I0Fg2w) comparing past and present prices at Costco illustrates.

## CDC Ends Vaccination Card Program
The Center for Disease Control announced it was [no longer printing the white Covid-19 vaccination cards](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFu5CAQgOGnwR0WDDZrChfXWNfsNVektNhhsCdiwcLIq337KKlT_82v7-O-3j0nzts__6S5xbJ6bHzRqpW0EswKXZgjEZDpaNbW2dENRtlun8fbpKKOZhpAjc6MMNghBjORJ6seaDqeQYHRSlnlxhGgdyZajZPGiKMDh2JQFLiV2n8Wzm2nmN7lotpjeXZp3ls7TmH-CFgELP6BmV5nv5XvLGD5Sz61XcDy4kr_W6lvActWSni8SWK5OEjt5OUROfvGJUv0NUgMKM9WjoOCPCrnxnmTWpmb0WBNV-dwvDglPu1NDGp7ek4_P-1Xna8AAAD__91VZcc) that many Americans once carried to ensure entrance into public events, airplanes, and restaurants. The federal government shipped more than 980 million cards between late 2020, when the first vaccines came out, through May 10 of this year. The CDC doesn't expect the end of vaccination cards to have a major effect. People who need their immunization records can usually get them from their pharmacy. [Here's a list of the big pharmacy chains](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DGu4yAQANDT4A4LD4GYgmIbd9l2S4sMQzwrDBFmbeX2q__rf4On9-exPgJnLq_fYSffU10Ddj5pnZS0EvQKQ_SJCEgP5CfrrHE3reyw-WnG2UGYEI2ZQ4jWpQiaZiJ6mqe5D-xBgZ6UssoZAzA6neyE84QJjQOH4qYocq9t_Fu59I1S_tST2oh1H7Lfen8fQv8SsAhYrusaQ2jvsbaXgGWjkPsmYMFaIneu5ZC9Ueg7lX4IWLikKr8AApZY5af-k4UoSqwnR3kGRC4kMbQ4bn3PQ_PxfXHOfNi7uKnXHjh_Q_qPLf8DAAD__0kKZTw) and their policies on vaccination records.

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. | | **URGENT ACTION NEEDED: More than 36,000 acres of public lands in Wyoming could be DESTROYED by greedy companies' fracking operations![_Sign now to help CANCEL the lease sale!_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2035454?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)** When fossil fuel corporations **shoot high-pressure water** into the ground, it **cracks the Earth** ,**destabilizes the ground** , and sometimes **triggers earthquakes.** The wastewater from fracking can contain **RADIOACTIVE WASTE** and contaminate local drinking water. We must protect our precious public lands from fracking disasters, Friend! The Department of Interior has posted yet another lease sale, this time in Wyoming. But the good news is that comments from people like you have already pushed the DOI to defer selling parcels that contained Greater sage-grouse habitat. **The DOI is listening to comments – help us submit even more and CANCEL this lease sale for good!** [_**Please, Friend, take just 30 seconds to tell the DOI to PROTECT our public lands in Wyoming from greedy polluters!**_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2035455?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) ***COMMENT DEADLINE IS OCT 19th – SUBMIT YOURS NOW!** | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2035456?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

I’m sure you’ve noticed the devastating increase in floods, fires, and storms across the world this past summer. Maybe you even lived in one of the places where we couldn’t go outside because of wildfire smoke. The climate crisis is being accelerated by burning fossil fuels – **fracking on our public lands will make that problem even worse.**
Marine heatwaves are KILLING OFF coral, fish, and other precious marine animals. Horrifying floods are washing away people’s homes, their entire livelihoods. **Nearly a quarter of U.S. emissions comes from fossil fuel extraction on public lands.** It’s up to us to end it – one lease sale at a time.
[_**Stop greedy companies from bringing fossil fuels from our public lands. Send your message to the DOI by 11:59pm TONIGHT!**_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2035457?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

Dave's journey began in a small town in Pennsylvania, where he was raised by two hard-working teachers. His childhood was marked by the simple pleasures of winter deer hunting, and summers spent trimming Christmas trees on the family farm. But high school wrestling ignited a spark in Dave, a passion that would shape his path in ways he never imagined.

Wrestling opened doors to opportunities that seemed out of reach. It led Dave to West Point, where he pursued his love for the sport and embarked on a lifelong commitment to serve our nation. His relentless dedication and unwavering spirit propelled him through the ranks, eventually earning him the honor of becoming a paratrooper and a 2nd Lieutenant.

However, Dave's journey took an unexpected turn when he received orders to deploy to the Gulf War as part of Operation Desert Storm. The secrecy and chaos surrounding their mission meant they couldn't say goodbye to their families, and communication was limited to handwritten letters. Dave wrote to his parents as often as he could, with his mother cherishing those letters in a box at home.

Just before Christmas, a massive box arrived at their desert camp. To Dave and his fellow soldiers' astonishment, it contained a Christmas tree personally selected by Dave's father from their family farm. In the Saudi desert, thousands of miles away from home, Dave and his fellow soldiers experienced a fleeting moment of Christmas joy and a profound reminder of their roots. Even the most battle-hardened soldiers couldn't help but smile at this unexpected blessing.

_This story embodies Dave 's character, dedication to our country, and his vision for a brighter America. It's a story that speaks to the core of who Dave is and what motivates him to serve. _

**[Our nation is at a critical crossroads, and we need strong conservative leaders who will stand and fiercely defend the values that make America great. | | | Donald Trump is on trial for fraudulently inflating the value of his assets to get loans. And he continues to insist that his property in Florida, Mar-a-Lago, is worth over $1.5 billion, nearly 100 times the value assessed for tax purposes Well, if Trump insists the property is worth 100 times as much, then his property taxes should go up 100x as well. That’s exactly what Democratic Congressman Jared Moskowitz from Florida [has proposed](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tbf25f91a-acc4-4045-b318-eff994ddaad5/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9), and he has asked the Florida official overseeing appraisals to use Trump’s figure for tax purposes. We couldn’t agree more! Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is _personal_ and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

He's taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. Did you see the latest Cook Political Report, Peter?
_As of September 27th, 2023, they have NY-17, OUR district, rated as a_ _**“Republican Toss-Up.”**_
We already knew that this district is at the top of Democrats’ list to flip in 2024 but do you realize what’s at stake?

* While Mike fights for lower taxes and eliminating the SALT cap, his far-left opponents are talking about INCREASING taxes to pay for their radical political wishlist.

* While Mike is working across the aisle to put forward common-sense, bipartisan solutions to our problems, his extremist opponents have a “my way or the highway” mentality.

You must see this update if you care about securing our border. Read more >>> | | | [](http://links.fighttheswamp.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=c44838d9a7cc4c8a8bf3816e8fac0e4b&_e=Y0DYrLhP7F4vrBkBn-rYHC6hK1NfaByUpdEotYyEHQquuxs_L8f4q5w-5wcsMogAOeaJk8vZ5iGmPajbEpbnOO7XUPJSee5CE76w6kMB2WhhfrNMwrDKKrN8Y5KYdaFj9tQuVddrOHKdNCeABvgga0nL0VSkcjpvvU8G_8QGOQN0Jje4aM1dpLqMMtxEu7xSGu1EcYHa1ZKizZVG_QDcUWQQ9-q6XjdUvK6Zq3Bt_H6nkaTFjsKOxlyZOixsVWSE9fo28WC38Arnp_sCSo5-IR3wkUJCQ_HkPaMfaWek0AO7otH00Hn8AzDnndFwFUfFTI_7Bqf40TXkzfeokQuLlPegKCnYvGyWNkUl3YthZGkeZwSqB2N_IN2oIw3sy0fG-LFwILn4gUjE5E47faJWzF8CKaxngTK_fSytipV574tGPqrSdr2g1hAtApqyJDwMKrCGX5gKJ7KK8gSfjJjTzlfGjO78IV_tAbj5qgS3CbQ49ra5AFgFkpKY1sFZYHp3OoMcW0eKUesEN4lbhNVcsexy7wK_HSArto1qwL1gVGm0xIi_TU3d86dQ-1-i8W_mQinp5I4wYkavzNkhTZeWFQ%3D%3D)
---
Fellow Conservative, Operation Lone Star (OLS) is a Texas state operation to defend our southern border. Since its inception in 2021, Operation Lone Star has made a major positive impact for Texas and America. In that time, OLS has apprehended nearly 400,000 illegal immigrants and made over 30,000 criminal arrests. Why would any Texan be against this? There's no doubt that OLS has SAVED LIVES and helped slow down the avalanche of opioids and fentanyl being smuggled over the border. **That 's why it's so shameful that Colin Allred - the Democrat running to take me on in next year's United States Senate Race - voted to **_**DEFUND**_**this life-saving program. **
---
[**PITCH IN TO FIGHT BACK**](http://links.fighttheswamp.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=c44838d9a7cc4c8a8bf3816e8fac0e4b&_e=Y0DYrLhP7F4vrBkBn-rYHC6hK1NfaByUpdEotYyEHQquuxs_L8f4q5w-5wcsMogAOeaJk8vZ5iGmPajbEpbnOO7XUPJSee5CE76w6kMB2WhhfrNMwrDKKrN8Y5KYdaFj9tQuVddrOHKdNCeABvgga0nL0VSkcjpvvU8G_8QGOQN0Jje4aM1dpLqMMtxEu7xSGu1EcYHa1ZKizZVG_QDcUWQQ9-q6XjdUvK6Zq3Bt_H6nkaTFjsKOxlyZOixsVWSE9fo28WC38Arnp_sCSo5-IR3wkUJCQ_HkPaMfaWek0AO7otH00Hn8AzDnndFwFUfFTI_7Bqf40TXkzfeokQuLlPegKCnYvGyWNkUl3YthZGkeZwSqB2N_IN2oIw3sy0fG-LFwILn4gUjE5E47faJWzF8CKaxngTK_fSytipV574tGPqrSdr2g1hAtApqyJDwM-c8ujEFrSnZ9k0DIKPiVT6sl9Pqy8-3ZB6_U6YNethsjTiCySuGDLn7sudSHqXsg3cdG4eykvVE6A-qLStgdFnvo6N8AmRvsjI4POLYV-qDX6WBzobSOWbUMc8RNx7gks8EYuriEuKluUD0t80_tJA%3D%3D)
---

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/timsanchez?refcode=X_welcomewebsitesignups_a [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/timsanchez?refcode=X_welcomewebsitesignups_a] Hi there friend,
Thanks for signing on and joining Team Tim Sanchez! I wanted to take some time to properly introduce myself to you. My name is Tim Sanchez and I am running for Congress in California’s 12th district to serve the community that shaped me.
As a proud son of East Oakland, a dedicated dad, and a grateful veteran, I am determined to serve my community and fight for the values we hold dear – because I know that this area is truly special.
If you want to cut right to the chase, will you consider chipping in to my campaign today? Even a few dollars goes a long way. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/timsanchez?refcode=X_welcomewebsitesignups_a&]
My family goes back 95 years in the Oakland and Berkeley area. I am a product of the Oakland Unified School District. My father and grandfather both served as pastors of a small Spanish church here, so I have a very strong religious upbringing (I’m considered the family heathen because I didn’t follow in their footsteps). But even though I didn’t follow in their footsteps, I still hold their lessons of public service close to my heart.
I was the first in my family to go to college, but unfortunately I had to drop out at the age of 19 when I became a teenage parent and needed to support my young family. It wasn’t the easiest situation, but I figured out early in life how to face challenges head-on, learning lessons that have served me well in my long career as an entrepreneur, small business owner, an active duty service member, and a financial services professional in the private sector.
I eventually went back to school and earned my degree from the University of San Francisco and a dual MBA from Columbia University and the Haas School of Business at the University of California, Berkeley, and signed up to serve in the military after 9/11. I’m proud of my service and have been serving ever since as Lieutenant Commander in the Navy Reserves, including my three tours overseas in Kuwait, Bahrain, and Afghanistan.
Today, the kid I had when I was 19 is a successful college graduate. In fact, all 3 of my kids have graduated or are about to graduate from college. Of everything I’ve accomplished, I’m most proud of that fact.
So that’s my story.
Fast forward to today, I decided running for office would be the best thing I could do to help my community right now.
My diverse experiences have informed the priorities that I’ll bring to Congress for California’s 12th district residents: creating economic opportunity for working families, expanding health care for all residents, and protecting and strengthening our democracy from MAGA extremists and anyone else who threatens it.
Now I’m asking you to join me because every campaign is only as strong as its base. Will you chip in whatever you can today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/timsanchez?refcode=X_welcomewebsitesignups_a&]
Thank you so much,
Tim Sanchez

As a proud son of East Oakland, a dedicated father, and a veteran, he knows firsthand the challenges that working families in the East Bay face. He is ready to deliver progress for all of us and continue the tradition of progressive leadership of doing what’s right – even if that means being the lone voice.

name: Jenny Beth Martin, Tea Party Patriots Action
subject: Urgent: Another survey – Jim Jordan for Speaker?
body:
| | |
---
We heard from thousands of you through the survey we sent out yesterday. Many of you mentioned you wanted us to endorse a specific person. So, with that in mind, I need to hear from you once more. I need to know if you want Tea Party Patriots Action to **1)** **endorse** **someone in particular or only demand certain promises/principles,** and then separately, **2) do you want us to endorse Jim Jordan,** knowing that President Trump is no longer in the running and that he has endorsed Jim Jordan. _**[Fill out this short survey to let me know.](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._aB8RDmTA)**_ **Pros and cons of endorsing a specific person** There are pros to endorsing a specific person and pros to only demanding a set of principles that we would want anyone to adhere to as Speaker. If we endorse a specific person, we can help rally support for him and perhaps see someone we actually like become Speaker. If we simply stick to a set of principles, we allow more freedom to our allies in the House to figure out what needs to be done. **What are the arguments for Jim Jordan in particular?** As an organization, based on grassroots feedback, we endorsed Jim Jordan for Speaker 8 years ago, but at that time he didn’t even want to be considered. He is now finally stepping up and attempting to take on this task. We now know President Trump is going to endorse him as well. He has been conservative and aligned with the conservative movement for many years, has publicly spoken in defense of conservatives being targeted by the DOJ (and other agencies), and was instrumental in fighting against the bogus impeachments of President Trump, etc. Finally, he says the most important thing is telling the truth to the American people, which would be a refreshing change.
---
[COMPLETE MY SURVEY](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.)
---
_Note: Whoever becomes Speaker first needs to be able to get 218 votes, and we all must understand that we will at some point be disappointed because all of them are human. However, we can hope for the best, most conservative person to win; someone, ideally, who we trust more than Kevin McCarthy, Paul Ryan, or John Boehner._ As things are moving quickly, I need to know what you think as soon as possible, so that I can best reflect the grassroots when I am asked. Thank you! In liberty, Jenny Beth Martin

name: David Hogg, Leaders We Deserve
subject: BINGO: Biden just delivered for young Americans
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Serve America PAC
body:
I’m (almost) at a loss for words sharing this announcement with you, friend:
President Joe Biden just announced the creation of a federal Office of Gun Violence Prevention.
This win couldn’t have happened without the non-stop work of young leaders and activists across the country, including everyone at March For Our Lives. After four long years of protests, registering thousands of young voters, meeting after meeting, and MANY Zoom calls...we did it!!!
I’ll share more about the work young leaders did to get us to this point, but first: Please split a donation of $20 today between Leaders We Deserve and Serve America to help carry this momentum forward and elect the leaders we deserve. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-lwd]
Here’s why we can draw a direct line from our work to the Biden administration’s new Office of Gun Violence Prevention, friend.
When we talk about electing the “leaders we deserve,” we’re talking about folks like Maxwell Frost, one of our Advisory Board members and the first Gen-Z Member of Congress.
Maxwell served as the first National Organizing Director for March For Our Lives and really helped us level-up our organizing work, especially on behalf of a federal Office of Gun Violence Prevention. We did everything from asking presidential candidates about opening that department if they were elected at our 2020 Gun Safety Forum to sleeping on an office floor in the Virginia House of Delegates to ensure we were able to lobby on behalf of gun violence prevention, while armed white supremacists pointed guns at them through windows.
The very first bill he introduced on the House floor was to establish a federal Office of Gun Violence Prevention. Republicans blocked it, but he didn’t give up, and neither did we. Even when it became clear that NRA-sponsored politicians weren’t going to let his bill pass, President Biden stepped in. In fact, Vice President Kamala Harris introduced Maxwell at the official announcement of the Office of GVP, and Maxwell got to introduce President Biden!!
And when we talk about leveraging the power of the youth vote, we’re talking about years of record-breaking youth voting turnout that led us to this announcement.
In the last five years, we went from having the most pro-NRA president in American history to the most pro-gun safety president in American history. Young people were critical in electing Biden.
Our voices and votes matter. But we need to elect more young people to make sure we build power on the inside and outside of politics
Help us carry this momentum and get more life-saving sh*t done by splitting a donation of $20 between Serve America and Leaders We Deserve. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-lwd]
We should celebrate this momentous victory, friend — but it doesn’t mean we can slow down or stop anytime soon.
There is still so much work to be done, from tackling the climate crisis to expanding abortion access to building a country that isn’t run by the rich and powerful few.
There is a long road ahead of us, and we need your help if we’re going to score more wins, elect more young people to office, and stop the fascist takeover of our country.
If you’re celebrating this victory, but are ready for the important work ahead, please split a donation between Leaders We Deserve and Serve America to help fund our work. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-lwd]
Thanks for your support, friend. Together, we will keep making the progress we deserve.
David Hogg
P.S. Me when we finally get the Office of Gun Violence Prevention 👇😊

Dear Friends,

I am sure you have heard the good news that Rep. Kevin McCarthy has been officially ousted as Speaker of the House. This is our opportunity to have a conservative for Speaker. I am supporting Rep. Jim Jordan of Ohio.

Rep. Jordan and Rep. Steve Scalise are running in the Republican Conference for Speaker. They are both good men. I believe Rep. Jordan will do a better job. He is a Freedom Caucus member who is serving our country well as Chairman of the House Judiciary Committee. Before that, Rep. Jordan proved his toughness by standing up to Democrats as the Ranking Member of the House Oversight Committee. Rep. Jordan has proved to be a true conservative and a careful manager of important congressional committees. I believe he is the best candidate for Speaker.

I am currently contacting Virginia's Republican Congressional Delegation to whip the vote for Rep. Jordan for Speaker, and I ask you to join me.

Please call their D.C. Office and press them to vote for Rep. Jim Jordan of Ohio for Speaker of the House.

Rep. Rob Wittman, VA-1

President Joe Biden just announced the creation of a federal Office of Gun Violence Prevention.

| I’m (almost) at a loss for words sharing this announcement with you, Peter:

**President Joe Biden just announced the creation of a federal Office of Gun Violence Prevention.**

This win couldn’t have happened without the non-stop work of young leaders and activists across the country, including everyone at March For Our Lives. After four long years of protests, registering thousands of young voters, meeting after meeting, and MANY Zoom calls...we did it!!!

I’ll share more about the work young leaders did to get us to this point, but first: [_**Please split a donation of $25 today between Leaders We Deserve and Stop Gun Violence PAC to help carry this momentum forward and elect the leaders we deserve.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/71085326/431112199/-68786849?refcode=BLU-SGVP-20231006-1-EM&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDQ0NTkiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiY2M5MWJkNTktNTE2NC1lZTExLTk5MzctMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=SS-9V1bSkUexaTKgpKji-BetUYjK42nTtv71njsOvYk=)

**Here’s why we can draw a direct line from our work to the Biden administration’s new Office of Gun Violence Prevention, Peter.

When we talk about electing the “leaders we deserve,” we’re talking about folks like Maxwell Frost, one of our Advisory Board members and the first Gen-Z Member of Congress.**

Maxwell served as the first National Organizing Director for March For Our Lives and really helped us level-up our organizing work, especially on behalf of a federal Office of Gun Violence Prevention. We did everything from asking presidential candidates about opening that department if they were elected at our 2020 Gun Safety Forum to sleeping on an office floor in the Virginia House of Delegates to ensure we were able to lobby on behalf of gun violence prevention, while armed white supremacists pointed guns at them through windows.

The very first bill he introduced on the House floor was to establish a federal Office of Gun Violence Prevention. Republicans blocked it, but he didn’t give up, and neither did we. Even when it became clear that NRA-sponsored politicians weren’t going to let his bill pass, President Biden stepped in. In fact, Vice President Kamala Harris introduced Maxwell at the official announcement of the Office of GVP, and Maxwell got to introduce President Biden!!

**And when we talk about leveraging the power of the youth vote, we’re talking about years of record-breaking youth voting turnout that led us to this announcement.**

In the last five years, we went from having the most pro-NRA president in American history to the most pro-gun safety president in American history. Young people were critical in electing Biden.

Our voices and votes matter. But we need to elect more young people to make sure we build power on the inside and outside of politics.

[_**Help us carry this momentum and get more life-saving sh*t done by splitting a donation of $25 between Stop Gun Violence PAC and Leaders We Deserve.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/71085332/431112202/-68786849?refcode=BLU-SGVP-20231006-1-EM&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDQ0NTkiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiY2M5MWJkNTktNTE2NC1lZTExLTk5MzctMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=SS-9V1bSkUexaTKgpKji-BetUYjK42nTtv71njsOvYk=)

We should celebrate this momentous victory, Peter — but it doesn’t mean we can slow down or stop anytime soon.

There is still so much work to be done, from tackling the climate crisis to expanding abortion access to building a country that isn’t run by the rich and powerful few.

There is a long road ahead of us, and we need your help if we’re going to score more wins, elect more young people to office, and stop the fascist takeover of our country.

clean_body: President Joe Biden just announced the creation of a federal Office of Gun Violence Prevention. | I’m (almost) at a loss for words sharing this announcement with you, Peter: President Joe Biden just announced the creation of a federal Office of Gun Violence Prevention. This win couldn’t have happened without the non-stop work of young leaders and activists across the country, including everyone at March For Our Lives. After four long years of protests, registering thousands of young voters, meeting after meeting, and MANY Zoom calls...we did it!!! I’ll share more about the work young leaders did to get us to this point, but first: = | = Here’s why we can draw a direct line from our work to the Biden administration’s new Office of Gun Violence Prevention, Peter. When we talk about electing the “leaders we deserve,” we’re talking about folks like Maxwell Frost, one of our Advisory Board members and the first Gen-Z Member of Congress. Maxwell served as the first National Organizing Director for March For Our Lives and really helped us level-up our organizing work, especially on behalf of a federal Office of Gun Violence Prevention. We did everything from asking presidential candidates about opening that department if they were elected at our 2020 Gun Safety Forum to sleeping on an office floor in the Virginia House of Delegates to ensure we were able to lobby on behalf of gun violence prevention, while armed white supremacists pointed guns at them through windows. The very first bill he introduced on the House floor was to establish a federal Office of Gun Violence Prevention. Republicans blocked it, but he didn’t give up, and neither did we. Even when it became clear that NRA-sponsored politicians weren’t going to let his bill pass, President Biden stepped in. In fact, Vice President Kamala Harris introduced Maxwell at the official announcement of the Office of GVP, and Maxwell got to introduce President Biden!! And when we talk about leveraging the power of the youth vote, we’re talking about years of record-breaking youth voting turnout that led us to this announcement. In the last five years, we went from having the most pro-NRA president in American history to the most pro-gun safety president in American history. Young people were critical in electing Biden. Our voices and votes matter. But we need to elect more young people to make sure we build power on the inside and outside of politics. = We should celebrate this momentous victory, Peter — but it doesn’t mean we can slow down or stop anytime soon. There is still so much work to be done, from tackling the climate crisis to expanding abortion access to building a country that isn’t run by the rich and powerful few. There is a long road ahead of us, and we need your help if we’re going to score more wins, elect more young people to office, and stop the fascist takeover of our country. = | | | = | = | = | = | = Thanks for your support, Peter. subject: Gun violence is a threat to our democracy

body:
We cannot accept political violence as normal or excusable in our society
#

This week, a disturbing scene unfolded at the Wisconsin State Capitol when a man tried to bring a handgun into the building. His target was Governor Tony Evers.
The suspect was arrested. But then he posted bail and returned to the capitol with an assault rifle later that night.
This should sound alarm bells for us all.
The use of guns to intimidate and threaten voters, elected officials, and peaceful demonstrators poses a serious threat to our democracy.
Political violence has become far too common in America. Earlier this year, GIFFORDS Law Center released a report regarding this uptick in violence. We all remember the violent insurrectionists that stormed the U.S. Capitol on January 6th, 2021. After this horrific event, polling in late 2022 found a quarter of Americans thought violence was either “definitely” or “probably” justifiable against the government, with one in 10 Americans saying that such violence was justifiable “right now.”
This school of thought is a danger to the very fibers of our democracy. When there is a threat of violence in the halls of our government buildings or against our elected officials, it jeopardizes our democracy—the soul of our nation. We cannot accept political violence as normal or excusable in our society.
[**At GIFFORDS, we are committed to keeping up our work to fight back against political violence and uphold our democracy. Please, consider making a contribution of $3 today to join us in this crucial fight.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-oct23.zcsGXG&refcode=em231006-1-30&t=1&akid=6689%2E3935704%2Eb74ZZj)

|

| [](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/580118?id=578437.4226.1.472cc6b44a70c78a34eaa694a5b024a6)
---
Ask the average, well-prepared patriot what they stock up on in case of an emergency and the answers might be something like:
---
* Food
* Water
* Ammo
* And precious metals

---
But even the most prepared Americans are sorely lacking the critical medications that can protect them from **anthrax, tick bites, COVID and even bioweapons**. And it’s not because of a lack of knowledge either. Looking back at the pandemic, the US government was able to force an experimental vaccine on the population **helping big pharma rake in $1,000 of profit every second**. But if you want a simple antibiotic, then you better be prepared to jump through hoops to prove why you need it. Luckily**a small group of patriotic doctors, pharmacists and business leaders** have had enough with the corrupting influence of big pharma. As champions of medical freedom, The Wellness Company has made it easy for Americans to get the **critical medications** they need. That’s why they created the [prescription medical emergency kit.](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/580118?id=578437.4227.1.15246f9ff2cd40759b57179b5e65b9cc "http://google.com") Inside you’ll find an assortment of the 8 most critical, life-saving prescriptions you need to keep you and your loved ones safe. [The Wellness Company Medical Emergency Kit includes:](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/580118?id=578437.4228.1.9239c43cb4e1716c48319d642604c8e1 "http://google.com")
---
* Ivermectin 18mg – 7 compounded capsules
* Amoxicillin-Clavulanate (generic Augmentin) 875/125 mg – 28 tablets
* Azithromycin (generic Z-Pak) 250 mg – 12 tablets
* Doxycycline Hyclate 100 mg – 60 capsules
* Metronidazole (generic Flagyl) 500 mg – 30 tablets
* Trimethoprim-Sulfamethoxazole (generic Bactrim) 800/160 mg – 28 tablets
* Fluconazole (generic Diflucan) 150 mg – 2 tablets
* Ondansetron (generic Zofran) 4mg – 6 tablets
* 1 virtual consult for the kit prescription from a doctor you can trust
* 1 Emergency Medication Guidebook written by our Chief Medical Board for safe use

---
[The Wellness Company Medical Emergency Kit treats:](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/580118?id=578437.4229.1.8123457f6a25df3c6c694b6eb9c5d4e9 "http://google.com")
---
1. Anthrax
2. Bacterial Vaginosis
3. Bite Wounds
4. Bronchitis
5. Chlamydia
6. Clostridioides difficile
7. Colitis
8. COVID – 19
9. Gonorrhea
10. Giardiasis
11. Lice
12. Nausea & Vomiting
13. Pharyngitis
14. Pinworms
15. Plague (bioterror)
16. Pneumonia
17. Rickettsial Infections
18. Scabies
19. Shigella Infection
20. Sinusitis
21. Skin Infection
22. Strep Throat
23. Syphilis
24. Tetanus
25. Tick Exposure
26. Tonsillitis
27. Travelers Diarrhea
28. Trichomoniasis
29. Tularemia (bioterror)
30. Urinary Tract Infection
31. Vaginal Candidiasis
32. Viral Upper Respiratory Infection

---
Now you could go through the hassle of trying to explain to your doctor why you need these prescriptions. But chances are you would only be wasting your time. **Thankfully, The Wellness Company’s telemed doctors are standing by, ready to write your prescription today.** When the crisis strikes, your Emergency Medical Kit will make sure you’re prepared. So do yourself and your loved ones a favor. [Get the Emergency Medical Kit today.](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/580118?id=578437.4230.1.bfd5b1ba5f66305025172978f21a9cbb "http://google.com") **It could save a life.**

body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMMP/1/85567/images/FVA-logo-05.png]
Hello Peter ,
During the 2023 legislative session, my team fought hard to pass a Prescription Drug Affordability Board and we made incredible progress. Earlier this year, Democratic members of the General Assembly, Senator Chap Petersen and Delegate Karrie Delaney, carried legislation [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?231+sum+SB957] which would have created a Prescription Drug Affordability Board (PDAB). The bill passed the Senate by a 26-13 margin with significant bipartisan support. The bill even had the backing of a broad range of groups, including AARP Virginia, the Virginia Catholic Conference, the Virginia Association of Counties [https://www.virginiamercury.com/2023/02/03/senate-oks-drug-affordability-board-bill-opposed-by-youngkin-administration/] and the Commonwealth Council on Aging. [https://sharepoint.wwrc.net/vdaBoards/council/_layouts/15/WopiFrame.aspx?sourcedoc=%7BEF4206BD-E3CB-46A6-BED5-A12137CDB082%7D&file=Annual%20Report%202022.pdf&action=default]
Unfortunately, Republicans in the House sided with big pharma and killed the bill which would have created an independent body tasked with analyzing the high cost of drugs and suggesting ways to lower spending.
Next year we’re bringing back PDAB as a top priority and we couldn’t be more excited to have support from candidates across the commonwealth like Susanna Gibson. As a nurse practitioner Susanna understands how medicine affordability affects our communities which is why she published this opinion piece [https://richmond.com/opinion/columnists/commentary-the-best-medicine-for-virginians-bring-down-drug-prices/article_552aef28-4c04-11ee-a200-972f509141d7.html] in the Richmond Times-Dispatch. You can read the article here [https://richmond.com/opinion/columnists/commentary-the-best-medicine-for-virginians-bring-down-drug-prices/article_552aef28-4c04-11ee-a200-972f509141d7.html] :
https://richmond.com/opinion/columnists/commentary-the-best-medicine-for-virginians-bring-down-drug-prices/article_552aef28-4c04-11ee-a200-972f509141d7.html [https://richmond.com/opinion/columnists/commentary-the-best-medicine-for-virginians-bring-down-drug-prices/article_552aef28-4c04-11ee-a200-972f509141d7.html]
That’s why we’re fighting for a PDAB in Virginia. As costs continue to rise in all aspects of life, we want to keep prescription costs low. Access to prescription medications at a reasonable price is a necessity for all people.
Thank you for your support,
Rhena Hicks

Madeleine joined fellow Pennsylvania delegation member, Senator John Fetterman, to introduce bicameral legislation to defer student loan payments for survivors of sexual violence. **[Here’s what Mad had to say](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/71091347/431133828/2018714094?refcode=10062023_md_mediaroundup_en_1&refcode2=4694ad08-5964-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0Njk0YWQwOC01OTY0LWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=T9pdsaspODY249DEcODpobzyVpNPxWWj9sEHcizoeWk=&emci=7b7fcdd2-1263-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&emdi=4694ad08-5964-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&ceid=36373569) **about this important legislation to the _Pennsylvania Capital-Star_ :
“After going through horrific trauma like harassment, stalking, or assault, survivors deserve the time to heal — and if they’re in school and need to step away from their education to do that, they must be able to do so without the worry or financial burden of student loan repayments beginning. **This deferment will help survivors focus on what’s most important: their mental and physical well-being.** ”

From House Republicans coming after President Biden with an unfounded impeachment inquiry, to a near-shutdown of the government thanks to Kevin McCarthy’s inability to unite his party that led to his historic ousting earlier this week, the work hasn’t slowed for a moment — and we don’t want you to miss these important updates from her! Check out the latest below: As a manager in the second impeachment of Donald Trump, Mad knows the serious implications of these inquiries. Not surprisingly, her colleagues across the aisle have put forth an inquiry that underscores that their loyalty is with Donald Trump, not our democracy. | | Madeleine joined fellow Pennsylvania delegation member, Senator John Fetterman, to introduce bicameral legislation to defer student loan payments for survivors of sexual violence. about this important legislation to the Pennsylvania Capital-Star : “After going through horrific trauma like harassment, stalking, or assault, survivors deserve the time to heal — and if they’re in school and need to step away from their education to do that, they must be able to do so without the worry or financial burden of student loan repayments beginning. This deferment will help survivors focus on what’s most important: their mental and physical well-being. ” | September was also National Recovery Month, and Mad and her son Harry had the chance to speak with PA Secretary of Drug & Alcohol Programs Dr. Latika Davis-Jones about substance use disorder, recovery, and hope. You can read more from the Pennsylvania Capital-Star | Bret Baier’s Fox News Podcast Common Ground revisited Madeleine’s conversation with her Republican colleague, Rep. Darrell Issa, where they discussed preventing drug and opioid overdose and addiction. Initially broadcast in March of last year, the issues remain largely the same, and it’s important to remember where we have common ground on the issues that impact Americans the most, especially when we’re seeing an epidemic like this one that’s taking the lives of our nation’s children. | Thanks for keeping up with Mad! Team Dean Madeleine is an attorney, professor, mother, grandmother, and Member of Congress, representing Pennsylvania’s 4th Congressional District of Berks and Montgomery Counties. She is an outspoken leader who champions progressive priorities such as education, universal access to healthcare, gun safety, and ethical government.Madeleine Dean has built a reputation for getting things done, and we need her to continue to be our voice to serve us in Congress. **Fellow Conservative.**

Please see this important message from fellow veteran Tim Sheehy, who's running for the U.S. Senate in Montana.

In service,
Tom Cotton

\-----------------------------------------------

Fellow Conservative,

My name is Tim Sheehy - I’m a former Navy SEAL, founder of a veteran aerial firefighting company that employs hundreds of Montanans, father of four beautiful kids, husband, and an American patriot.

I’ll never forget how I felt on 9/11. That fateful day motivated me to serve, and now I’m answering the call again. America needs true conservative leaders who will set-up and serve our GREAT nation. **My next mission is to defeat Liberal Democrat Senator Jon Tester and end his near quarter century political career.**

You may not know me yet, although I hope to change that today, but you do know what I stand for as a Navy SEAL; I’ve fought for you, for our freedoms and liberties, to protect and defend our nation from those who wish to do us harm on their own soil.

Career politicians like Montana Democrat Senator Jon Tester, who has been in elected office for nearly 25 years, are not getting the job done.**[That’s why I’m challenging him for his seat in the United States Senate.](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=cd5a923b7e034a8ab2320c5942c1c6c5&_e=0_CCsVp71atV3cpfmlcWK5u3SytjKtX5yzC4M4TYX-29zJBldKxIvWiMhgiQnmKxPsL8oiUVMjCHilNIRVwpMzSDtF-8UGqEgmes4Wzo4bZ_AaYe9M_O5ZCQy9wuNm0kNWVfe12pjL2yWvhQ183TtRp1fK7uQILTfdQsrQ8VsZw-hdsiio_kHId_hgEyU85W1KsPHx9easysRug57So6kXwjH32jNAC5PahJP4EFF8vgEKIq8HGxp916slIYaHiY-oRwzcg51OU9_JVebhpTMnY-SHC9h8KsPJAZY3wq3H9WrfOx8zlyCm33yGvlXyZbZghb2qyLZnnvC7HHNTi_FJsurGqS739y8mS4ahxPoS89xiJSZY0qf2wdTEWZK_fCnWficts4ybKnGguc8cej7-aG2Bs6L_NvwmisimSn8SA%3D) **

Friends --
Michigan is going to be one of the most competitive and expensive states in the country next cycle.
But don't take our word for it. Take it straight from the headlines:
_“Nowhere are the national stakes of the 2024 election higher than in Michigan -- the only swing state with an open Senate seat...Michigan will therefore play a crucial role in deciding both the balance of power in the upper chamber of Congress and the next occupant of the White House.”_
This is evidence of what we’ve known as a team: Despite Democrats’ success last year, Michigan is inherently a swing state, and we know it can flip red under the right conditions. When you’re a swing state, you swing!
And with a presidential election on the ballot as well, this election cycle is especially susceptible to that pendulum: The public polling released so far shows that not only is our race currently neck-and-neck, but a potential match-up between President Biden and former President Trump is a tie.
That’s why we’ve been doing everything we can to take our message directly to voters early by visiting cities and towns all over Michigan and meeting with folks to talk about the issues that matter to them.
Michigan is where it's at in 2024. The whole country will be watching us to see how we fare. So please:

| Friends,
Would you like to be a part changing history in our state? We are seeking volunteers to help get voter ID on the ballot in Massachusetts. We believe if it gets on the ballot, the voters will support it.
That is where you come in. Whether you take a petition and have family members and neighbors sign or you stand out at your local supermarket to collect signatures, everyone's help is needed and appreciated every signature helps us reach our goal.

Our first couple of weekends have been spent getting this campaign off the ground and the weather has also hindered us from reaching our signature threshold goals, so we are reaching out to you with a call to action.
---
| We cannot let the rain stop us !
---
|
---
| | [VOLUNTEER HERE ](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001tndjmG1cFG_wp8WhCiD4pubqBEHlF1OnZ197LOaE1oxo92D0lRDrA8f3_Vs5aqWu7A0YzA6mTEivWVcU8hw7XfYVrNgB04t3Ouhgh7Cf1nuPGSwf8Eoph8Wo4Zh228uFD1z_7DcCFt9eQZ65r758l87QgyMcVN2-XGfnFz8kjBf_SNjWwgG9R6XR6_4Jiq6Kmqd6k5NJQBc=&c=iKKQXmCcFaESS1Xe6lrS5BwdXzuGjyfLM3ATABIg7Nu4nieeHeEJRQ==&ch=3qvuk5gtE3ZoTb_ydDDA9n7dUTWclRGWF_nEy40C04kG07su65jnuQ==)
---

We need an army, 90,000 signatures by November 22nd is no small task but failure is not an option. There is no time to waste. Our deadline is quickly approaching so we are urging every volunteer to please begin their signature collection efforts. We are counting on you.
All of the details, instructions and the ability to print your own petition is on our website. [https://ma4voterid.org](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001tndjmG1cFG_wp8WhCiD4pubqBEHlF1OnZ197LOaE1oxo92D0lRDrA8f3_Vs5aqWu7A0YzA6mTEivWVcU8hw7XfYVrNgB04t3Ouhgh7Cf1nuPGSwf8Eoph8Wo4Zh228uFD1z_7DcCFt9eQZ65r758l87QgyMcVN2-XGfnFz8kjBf_SNjWwgG9R6XR6_4Jiq6Kmqd6k5NJQBc=&c=iKKQXmCcFaESS1Xe6lrS5BwdXzuGjyfLM3ATABIg7Nu4nieeHeEJRQ==&ch=3qvuk5gtE3ZoTb_ydDDA9n7dUTWclRGWF_nEy40C04kG07su65jnuQ==) You can also mail back your petitions already signed to the address on the front of the petition. It is clearly labeled. Please get your signatures certified first at your local city or town clerk before sending them back to us.
Town dumps (transfer stations), town meetings, and supermarkets have been our best venues. Special events like fairs, gun shows, and exhibits are also often crowded with folks who will sign.
Thank you so very much for carving the time out to make voter ID a reality in Massachusetts.
Thank you,
Caroline Colarusso

Friend— A bowl of cereal. Your avocado toast. That craveable breakfast sandwich.

Farmers make those meals possible.

But the U.S. agriculture industry is contributing to over one-tenth of all greenhouse gas pollution—so how we get from farm to breakfast table matters.

**Farmers and ranchers want and need funding that supports local economies while making their farms more sustainable. **

Thankfully, the Inflation Reduction Act includes $19.5 billion (with a "b") for farmers and communities to use on sustainable, climate-smart agriculture.

**But Republicans are trying to use the 2023 Farm Bill to repeal these important and popular investments.**

[Learn why the upcoming Farm Bill is an important climate bill.](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/5035?t=12&akid=13727%2E53494%2ElCAPUD)

Over the coming months, we'll be sending you ways to advocate for climate-smart farming practices that are good for people and the planet.

**Until then, I'd love to hear what planet-friendly agriculture means to you.[Will you respond to this email and tell me why you support sustainable farming?](mailto:hello@evergreenaction.com?subject=Why%20I%20support%20sustainable%20farming "hello@evergreenaction.com")**

clean_body: Protecting cereal 🤝 protecting sustainable agriculture | | | | | | | Friend— A bowl of cereal. Your avocado toast. That craveable breakfast sandwich. Farmers make those meals possible. But the U.S. agriculture industry is contributing to over one-tenth of all greenhouse gas pollution—so how we get from farm to breakfast table matters. Farmers and ranchers want and need funding that supports local economies while making their farms more sustainable. Thankfully, the Inflation Reduction Act includes $19.5 billion (with a "b") for farmers and communities to use on sustainable, climate-smart agriculture. But Republicans are trying to use the 2023 Farm Bill to repeal these important and popular investments. Over the coming months, we'll be sending you ways to advocate for climate-smart farming practices that are good for people and the planet. Until then, I'd love to hear what planet-friendly agriculture means to you.mailto:hello@evergreenaction.com?subject=Why%20I%20support%20sustainable%20farming "hello@evergreenaction.com" mailto:hello@evergreenaction.com?subject=Why%20I%20support%20sustainable%20farming Sincerely, Mattea Mrkusic Policy Lead Evergreen Action | | | | | | ---|---|---|---

Friend,
---
Back in August, Tucker Carlson asked President Trump what his first priority will be after he wins back the White House.
---
**He answered ... _" The border."_**
---
Joe Biden has created a cartel's dream at our southern border. It's been left wide-open to an invasion by human traffickers, drug traffickers, and all manner of criminals.
---
**Enough fentanyl has poured into our country since Biden took office to KILL every single man, woman, and child in the United States.**
---
That's why I've made securing our southern border my number #1 priority, and I'm going to ensure our next Speaker makes it the #1 priority for our House majority.
---
_We need to use all the leverage we have to finish the wall and secure the border. I don 't care what kind of backlash there is from Democrats and the open borders lobby. _
---
This humanitarian and national security crisis has to end.
---
