When we learned that Kevin McCarthy had been ousted from his position as House Speaker this week after Florida Representative Matt Gaetz brought a motion to vacate the Speaker's chair to the House floor, many were reminded of the initial battle that McCarthy fought to obtain the position of Speaker of the House.
Matt Gaetz also led the charge in January of 2023, along with Representative Andy Biggs, to oppose Kevin McCarthy's Speaker bid. However, after 15 votes on the floor of the House in. contentious Speaker bid, McCarthy was reluctantly confirmed as House Speaker.
Colorado Congresswoman Lauren Boebert was one of the most vocal critics of McCarthy during the initial process of selecting the Speaker of the House after the 2022 midterms. You can see a video of Boebert objecting to McCarthy from her Twitter feed **[HERE](https://substack.com/redirect/62a12879-1db2-44cf-8c74-352e1392eb84?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**.

Through the Federal Election Commission's public campaign finance database, I confirmed that Boebert received over $130,000 through McCarthy's 'Protect The House 2024' joint fundraising committee since Boebert took her initial stand against McCarthy after the 2022 Election.

**Fellow Conservative.**

Please see this important message from fellow veteran Tim Sheehy, who's running for the U.S. Senate in Montana.

In service,
Tom Cotton

\-----------------------------------------------

Fellow Conservative,

My name is Tim Sheehy - I’m a former Navy SEAL, founder of a veteran aerial firefighting company that employs hundreds of Montanans, father of four beautiful kids, husband, and an American patriot.

I’ll never forget how I felt on 9/11. That fateful day motivated me to serve, and now I’m answering the call again. subject: Friend, can I count on you to personally endorse my campaign? This is important, so please take a moment to read why your voice is so important to our movement. - Ilhan
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ILHAN FOR CONGRESS
body:
The political insiders and special interests who never wanted a progressive, Somali, refugee, Muslim, Hijabi-wearing woman in Congress are going to come back with more money and resources than ever before to try to take me down in 2024
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=592%2E791427%2E7oZMsV)
Friend -
In just a minute, I'm going to ask you to add your name to **[personally endorse my re-election campaign for Congress.](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em231006-personal-endorse/?source=em231006-1-t4&refcode2=592.791427.7oZMsV&akid=592%2E791427%2E7oZMsV)** But before I do, please give me a chance to explain why your voice is so important to this movement.
Now, one thing you may know about my story is that I am a refugee.
When I was just a young child, my family was forced to escape civil war in Somalia, and we had to take sanctuary for four years in a Kenyan refugee camp.
We didn't always have food or running water. But we did always hold out hope that one day, we would be able to get out of that camp and start a new life in the United States.
At the time, I never could have even imagined I would someday run for office — nevermind become the first African-born member of Congress, or that tens of thousands of people across the country would be with me along the way.
I wouldn't have believed you if you told me. No way.
Each and every thing that our campaigns and our work in Congress has accomplished has only ever been possible because of people like you, and I want you to know that I am incredibly grateful to have your trust and support.
Every day I count my blessings — but the fact is, we still have a lot of work to do. The political insiders and special interests who never wanted a progressive, Somali, refugee, Muslim, Hijabi-wearing woman in Congress are going to come back with more money and resources than ever before to try to take me down in 2024.
If our movement is going to continue building progressive power and fighting for the values and issues we believe in like Medicare for All, climate action, and canceling student debt, it's going to take every single one of us standing together in solidarity.
That's why I'm asking:
**[Can you add your name to personally endorse my re-election today? I need as many people by my side as possible in this campaign, and it'd mean so much to see your name on our list today.](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em231006-personal-endorse/?source=em231006-1-t4&refcode2=592.791427.7oZMsV&akid=592%2E791427%2E7oZMsV)**
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em231006-personal-endorse/?source=em231006-1-t4&refcode2=592.791427.7oZMsV&akid=592%2E791427%2E7oZMsV)**
It may seem like a small and simple action, but your voice — when combined with thousands of progressives and fighters across the country — is more powerful than anything our opponents can throw at us.
From the very beginning, our movement's greatest strength has been our collective power. Thank you, as always, for being a part of it.
In solidarity,
Ilhan

body:
[1]Powered By People

We wanted to make sure you saw Beto’s email about the latest attacks on
women and reproductive freedom in Texas.

As Republicans in counties across Texas ban women from seeking an abortion
out of state and empower vigilantes to police women’s travel, it’s more
important than ever that we stand up for the women of this state and ramp
up our work to elect pro-choice candidates in 2024.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20231006.rREDeg&refcode=ema20231006-232963&t=1001&akid=232963%2E444211%2EUqYArJ ]Please consider donating $3 or whatever you can today to
ensure Powered by People has the resources to organize, register, and
mobilize the voters we need to replace Republican extremists with true
leaders who will stand up for women’s freedoms.

We couldn’t do this work without you.

— Powered by People

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Email from Beto from October 3, 2023 is forwarded below:

The thing to remember about Texas Republicans is that no matter how bad
you think it is, it can always get worse.

More than a year after enacting the most extreme abortion ban in the
nation — with no exception for rape or incest — they’ve found new ways to
try to intimidate and harass Texans who seek to make their own
reproductive healthcare choices.

Several Texas counties have recently passed ordinances to ban women from
driving to seek an abortion out of state — and as if that weren’t extreme
enough, the travel bans are enforceable by private citizens, empowering
vigilantes to police roads and harass women exercising whatever privacy
and freedom they have left to make their own decisions about their own
bodies.

According to the Texas Tribune:

“Anti-abortion advocates behind the measures are targeting regions along
interstates and in areas with airports, with the goal of blocking off
the main arteries out of Texas and keeping pregnant women hemmed within
the confines of their anti-abortion state.”

The latest travel ban passed on Thursday in Cochran County. Cochran
borders New Mexico, now the closest state where Texas women can legally
seek an abortion. (Texas’ three other neighboring states have full
abortion bans in place.)

It’s clearer now than ever before: this isn’t about protecting life. It’s
about controlling women.

But here’s what gives me hope. At least two Texas
counties have recently voted down this type of travel ban after receiving
immense public pressure from their constituents — proving that when we
organize, we can stop these authoritarian attacks on the lives of Texas
women.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20231006.rREDeg&refcode=ema20231006-232963&t=1002&akid=232963%2E444211%2EUqYArJ ]That’s why I’m asking you to chip in $3 today to support
Powered by People’s efforts to organize, register, and mobilize the voters
we need to fire Republican extremists in 2024 and replace them with true
leaders who will ensure every woman has the freedom to make her own
decisions about her own body, her own health care, and her own future.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20231006.rREDeg&refcode=ema20231006-232963&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=232963%2E444211%2EUqYArJ ]Donate $3

The next election will decide whether we’ll have strong local leaders in
place to block these measures at the city and county level, whether we’ll
have a fighting chance at overturning Texas’ abortion ban in the state
legislature, and, ultimately, whether Congress can stop a nationwide
abortion ban.

Powered by People has built a network of tens of thousands of volunteers
who are ready to register and turn out hundreds of thousands of new
Democratic voters who can help turn the tide of extremism in Texas.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20231006.rREDeg&refcode=ema20231006-232963&t=1022&akid=232963%2E444211%2EUqYArJ ]Your support ensures we have the resources to do this work — so thank
you for chipping in whatever you can today.

Thank you for being with us at this critical moment.

— Beto

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to act. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://act.betoorourke.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1023&akid=232963%2E444211%2EUqYArJ

name: Katie Porter
subject: California offers Democrats some of the best pick-up opportunities in the country
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Katie Porter for Senate
body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=31000%2E3422442%2Eletpfg)
I’m no stranger to tough races. In 2018, we flipped a historically red seat blue. In 2020 and 2022, we held this seat, even as Republicans spent millions last year on misleading TV attacks.
**Now, California offers Democrats some of the best pick-up opportunities in the nation.** By flipping just a few California House seats that are held by Republicans but went for Biden in 2020, we could regain the majority. And as a Senate candidate, I’m committed to not just winning my own race, but to uplifting Democrats down the ballot. [**Can you chip in right now to help us mobilize voters in key areas?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20231006-1?refcode=em20231006-1&refcode2=31000_3422442_letpfg&akid=31000%2E3422442%2Eletpfg)

##### **Ineligibles and The Aftermath******
Several weeks ago, True the Vote published a short paper titled [The Aftermath](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/1A5_Z39fk90fowLbTa71p3Hf2I_x3NUKZHTKEIA2irT--9e-V2LjS2o5fLv3iwjXIefnnv-h79X2rGFP6OYC6somcwSfC_dV9kwyRhyfEkLjtptKZ5MkRjrIc8lbkAOfE8qFCuaD8SkHhyqcCZ_IBgNnduj5mt04V-8yccar4TV6fJ6fudJ_sau0dfpx5QLg/407/tt2GEfBxQ5a4__Qs2F9slA/h2/cqItFjG9c9vzW05771ek7OvaYXKBYxF2YuEtMOAyhwQ). Written as part of a broader collection of our recent work in Georgia, The Aftermath addressed the impact Georgia’s dirty voter rolls had on the 2020 election and a meeting I had in 2020 with Secretary of State Brad Raffensperger and his team, where we discussed True the Vote’s plans to assist Georgia citizens in challenging ineligible voter records.
##### **The Lawsuit**
Our efforts were immediately met with a lawsuit filed against us by attorney Marc Elias on behalf of Stacey Abrams’ organization Fair Fight. The DOJ has now joined with Fair Fight against us. [This case has been ongoing since December 2020.](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/Qvk83lMrxpyahZ2UDrJlsUUkzv6S5IbZaiCcmLVvdD9aspWv3_CzE1fXyaE6ysvHZQ9ujLX6pAqbaN_Gy3Bf-m9pyLdZHogCk1V8FXt_vnAWss6rZicR8gMiqaf6JptMDxJXQl8o_g7KNSm6l-WdPzwLmgNxVNj3KJ14EhK0Yd-NqIBUg38UNzgtPl-kJm-T1LIe90FqgXW1Lr0hZTTQ1Q/407/tt2GEfBxQ5a4__Qs2F9slA/h3/NXggBUV37NXzbSjs0XNfTsIkUBKEfJJy8hdhFGI0-gc) Our federal court trial begins in Georgia on October 26th, 2023.
##### **The Indictments**
Now, [nineteen people](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/Qvk83lMrxpyahZ2UDrJlsVaR2TsPNOoWss_jdVaWzQ2VlbEynkfP5X-xzTxNqY8RGSG1II1ZMDSwJ6rV_qM6tYscNsZAuOsz79hDx9yp-DVOwy3qBCMEZnmTliRtc5z9JZ2JGLbZlbcnnOyX1PXz8vsg5VE_QHPAxfDMCkn4QErDqOhFlS5kIXPDaONWOZRpNEM2uWwpax-CI8OBTtGo_tLTfb0oCD69d4qq2apJJt3TSWG4DIKLHdzTgUKOreBB/407/tt2GEfBxQ5a4__Qs2F9slA/h4/oryeubBIDu9Sc-t6PRweA1CJ519QhMFL_yC6py2lPn0), including Donald Trump, have been indicted by Fulton County D. A. Fani Willis. She’s charged them with multiple felony counts over their involvement in the 2020 election, each related explicitly to whether there were known, potentially outcome-determinative inaccuracies in Georgia’s election that were being covered up.
##### **The Truth**
Seeing this, I decided to take what I’d written in The Aftermath and turn it into an affidavit. A [notarized copy is attached here](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/4xkviejVe2bcNHdbmWFEFkd9r7GYCwyhORTHbGFAJSqKPTTG9sO_uctLEoTsXeBJKM4jp-mLUYFGoPxlabNwzIGI7hulfBYgQOrzGgXJp3X78N8vV-DLfOBDNactZHFSXh-SOtSLBz9VYc43Z0ySTtI7hoZU4BcEixKKsTWfXWAxXsBgKQ4Tt0iSFCyuv6OCOi74TsxVMW2_bkLXzwqRnYx1anSCn-DlKge2ll9hrnM/407/tt2GEfBxQ5a4__Qs2F9slA/h5/MsSXuAgvbxGJp24rQr4AzMTEUenEStU4QbwS71cMgTw) for use in any way that may be helpful. Here’s an excerpt:
_“... I left the meeting unsettled by the seeming indifference the Raffensperger team had shown about their knowledge that the voter rolls had been so markedly inaccurate during the November election. At that time we did not yet have a copy of the state’s published record of voters in the General Election, but because the state uses services like ERIC, which also uses NCOA to identify ineligible records, the Secretary of State’s office knew, or should have known, there were hundreds of thousands of potentially ineligible voters casting votes, hence Raffensperger’s admonition that “The G.O.P should have been doing this all along.”_
_8\. Little more than two weeks later, on January 2nd, 2021, Secretary Raffensperger and members of his staff had a call with President Trump and members of his team. On that call, President Trump asked about inaccurate voter records. Both Secretary Raffensperger and General Counsel Ryan Germany stated that they had fully evaluated the various claims of election irregularities and said without qualification there was no evidence to support them, including no problems with the voting records. This statement was knowingly false. Both men were well-aware of that falsity at the time._
_9\. True the Vote has completed a review of the voting patterns relating to those 364,541 records identified as ineligible based on permanent change of residency._
_10\. In Georgia’s November 2020 elections, approximately 67,284 votes were cast that should likely not have been counted because the voters’ registrations were ineligible based on permanent change of residency._
_a. Out of County. 48,207 of those votes corresponded to voters who had moved to a different county within Georgia._
_b. Out of State. 19,077 of those votes corresponded to voters who no longer lived in Georgia._
_11\. While we cannot know who voted for which candidate in those ballots that should not have been counted, we do know that the two presidential candidates were separated by only 11,779 votes. It is of great concern that the number of votes for which the address verification requirement was essentially waived in the 2020 General Election could well have been outcome-determinative.”_
##### **Aftermath of The Aftermath**
This week, [Secretary Raffensperger announced efforts to evaluate, inactivate, or remove the voter registration records of 679,749 ineligible voter records. ](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/rJBsqjNfUS64oatT1OnWGM59SPOn3ak39SfpRgGWSHU5WKDzTGLHgLeD2A-MTXuc6UCkxnvCqsN_Ywt1nYdqRP7ee_H_Ga-VAlRR2LKckFZNcDYC2zmfYpTEeoejCTXnNSwpS9mCkVBddXyBRWbwOvtxe7gvWlXQGMvD9_gOiTM67tmFZIFNyhIFtPGtIpLod-HeD1TWqAiRvKfwLFfCAy17F3dmMmJn6E93ZAV2Z_zEQRWydeMW5smlD7YMGaQvypjxM4qEvTd5mTXaXq_s9g/407/tt2GEfBxQ5a4__Qs2F9slA/h6/oO-5gRYio8LerwsKIqetzlTr8omZy63txvYzbVaI2y8)
While we applaud what appear to be efforts to ensure only eligible voters vote in 2024, there were no such efforts in 2020. According to available state and federal data, over 300,000 ineligible records were on the rolls, and over 67,000 ineligible voters appear to have voted.
It was not only fitting for leaders to question the accuracy of the 2020 General Election, it was their obligation to do so.
May God guide us all through these dark days. May the journey make us stronger.
Ever onward -

They didn’t want to know the answers, so they prevented questions from being asked.
People have had enough. Things are changing for the better. Never quit.

body:
I can’t stay silent on this. I have seen too many political know-it-alls argue Kevin McCarthy is “moderate.”
|

Friend,

Kevin McCarthy is out as Speaker of the House, and I have seen too many political know-it-alls argue that Democrats should have saved him since he is “moderate.” I can’t stay silent on this. First, Kevin McCarthy is far from moderate. He did more than anyone to enable Donald Trump, to rehabilitate him after January 6, and to pave the way for his return to dominance in the Republican Party. Second, why would Democrats save him after his institutional role in threatening our democracy? In my eyes, he got what he deserved: **You play stupid games, you win stupid prizes.** I’m all about accountability, and Kevin McCarthy’s downfall is a small glimmer of hope for the worst House Republicans being held responsible for their actions. Sarah Longwell
Executive Director, Republican Accountability Project

Fellow Conservative, It’s no secret that woke corporations LOVE to punish conservatives. In recent years, we’ve seen social media companies censor users who refused to bend the knee to liberal orthodoxy. _**Now, the corporate world is taking its war against traditional Americans to the next level by attempting to deny right-leaning businesses financial services.**_ Yes, you read that right! Intuit, the owner of Quickbooks, issued a policy earlier this year that _**banned firearms manufacturers from using their services**_. This rule was dangerous and outrageous, and I immediately directed my staff on the Commerce Committee to open an _oversight investigation into Intuit’s business practices_. I also wrote to Intuit to express my opposition. **I’m happy to announce that Intuit has now removed this ridiculous policy from its terms of service. This is a solid victory for anyone who supports the right of every American to exercise his or her constitutional rights without fear of persecution.** But the battle isn’t over – not by a long shot. You can bet that left-wing corporations will continue to censor and deplatform conservatives. And I will continue to fight like hell to hold them accountable every time they try. If you support my efforts to STOP woke corporations from discriminating against Americans like you, please **[chip in what you can today](http://trk.tedcruz.-9Q)** to fuel my fight. For Liberty,

subject: what I told the school board
body:
I had to share my thoughts.

Earlier this week I spoke at my local school board to share my thoughts on the new so-called "Community Schools" initiative.

I was only permitted to speak for 60 seconds - there were a LOT of us there - but I wanted to share with you the video of what I told the school board. (https://secure.anedot.com/max-ukropina-for-congress-2024/parents-rights?utm_medium=Email&utm_source=Ukropina&utm_campaign=SaveSchools_10623&utm_source=Max+for+OC+Supporters&utm_campaign=ea7bc9ec0a-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_03_03_16_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_77339c80b8-590c33ecb3-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://secure.anedot.com/max-ukropina-for-congress-2024/parents-rights?utm_medium=Email&utm_source=Ukropina&utm_campaign=SaveSchools_10623&utm_source=Max+for+OC+Supporters&utm_campaign=ea7bc9ec0a-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_03_03_16_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_77339c80b8-590c33ecb3-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
This initiative is just another attempt by Left-wing consultants to spend tens of thousands in taxpayer money on Big Government programs that do absolutely nothing to actually educate children.

If you agree with what I said, I hope you'll click here and add your name so I know you're standing with me.

STAND WITH MAX (https://secure.anedot.com/max-ukropina-for-congress-2024/parents-rights?utm_medium=Email&utm_source=Ukropina&utm_campaign=SaveSchools_10623&utm_source=Max+for+OC+Supporters&utm_campaign=ea7bc9ec0a-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_03_03_16_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_77339c80b8-590c33ecb3-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
Why are school boards more concerned these days with using our already under-performing schools for ideological experiments than with improving students' proficiency in reading, writing, math, and science?

It was inspiring to see so many concerned parents at the school board meeting fighting for their kids' future.

The Democrats may demonize them ... but I'm running for Congress to fight for them. (https://secure.anedot.com/max-ukropina-for-congress-2024/parents-rights?utm_medium=Email&utm_source=Ukropina&utm_campaign=SaveSchools_10623&utm_source=Max+for+OC+Supporters&utm_campaign=ea7bc9ec0a-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_03_03_16_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_77339c80b8-590c33ecb3-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

I want to go to Washington to fight for parents rights in schools...

Oppose distracting political agendas that have no place in the classroom...

And ensure Orange County schools remain focused on the one thing they're expected to do: educate students.

There's too much at stake for me to sit on the sidelines. I hope you're with me, (https://secure.anedot.com/max-ukropina-for-congress-2024/parents-rights?utm_medium=Email&utm_source=Ukropina&utm_campaign=SaveSchools_10623&utm_source=Max+for+OC+Supporters&utm_campaign=ea7bc9ec0a-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_03_03_16_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_77339c80b8-590c33ecb3-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

- Max Ukropina

#
“For Supreme Court, ethics have become the elephant in the courtroom” - The Washington Post
Peter,
The Supreme Court began a new term this week—without a code of conduct in place.
We have seen allegations of serious ethical violations come to light over the last year time and time again.
Whether it is questionable financial disclosures from right-wing mega-donors or refusals to acknowledge conflicts of interest, the Supreme Court has shown us that a code of conduct is long overdue.
If the Supreme Court won’t act, then Congress will. Democrats are leading the push for ethics reform legislation, but I need your help. **[Will you add your name to my petition now calling for a Supreme Court code of conduct?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/71102525/431168488/1719215080?refcode=dd_em_231006_1&ms=dd_em_231006_1&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=Englewood&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODQ4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZTgyMTJjZS02OTY0LWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Db275BbcrsnXdUiJ6kQuu5YSa0gHziiDoqrWc9RbaFI=&emci=b4a9db0b-ad63-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&emdi=9e8212ce-6964-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&ceid=2727974)**
Polls show that the Supreme Court’s public approval has taken a significant dive in recent years. People must be able to trust the Supreme Court’s decision-making process if we want to protect our democracy.
I have repeatedly called for greater transparency, a code of conduct, and a recusal standard, but Republicans continue to stand in the way of moving Supreme Court ethics legislation along.
This period could come to define the Supreme Court. ****[Add your name now to support legislation for a Supreme Court code of conduct.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/71102528/431168489/1719215080?refcode=dd_em_231006_1&ms=dd_em_231006_1&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=Englewood&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODQ4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZTgyMTJjZS02OTY0LWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Db275BbcrsnXdUiJ6kQuu5YSa0gHziiDoqrWc9RbaFI=&emci=b4a9db0b-ad63-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&emdi=9e8212ce-6964-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&ceid=2727974)****
Your voice is essential in shaping and protecting our democracy.
My best,
Dick Durbin

**JFK**

_“Teaching Facts is NOT Indoctrination”_
**Anonymous**
JFK 's timeless words inspire us. As do the words and deeds of the good people of Central PA who are standing up for ALL our children's future.

We believe that every child in America should have the opportunity to benefit from a high-quality public education.

We believe a high-quality public education teaches all students the fundamentals of reading, writing, math, and science as a strong foundation.

We believe that a high-quality public education does _**NOT**_ limit which books our children read and which ideas they explore.

We believe that high-quality public education is the spark that ignites every student's thirst for knowledge, understanding, innovation, and determination to learn to work in diverse teams that will define the strength of America for generations to come.

Last night’s Inspirational ‘Love to Light the Night Rally’ at Temple Beth Shalom in Mechanicsburg brilliantly communicated all the above. It was an honor to stand amongst all those very good people.

Meanwhile, there is an alarming trend sweeping our nation: right-wing extremism pushing its dangerous agenda in our public schools.

Whether it’s draconian book bans, whitewashing curriculum, invalidating and endangering LGBTQ+ students, and more, extremists are intent on waging their culture war everywhere they can.

It seems Republicans like Scott Perry only want to keep politics out of schools when it goes against their narrow-minded, regressive views.

Even beyond the dangerous extremism taking hold, public education still faces underfunding across the country.

I believe that high-quality public education is essential to our democracy and to America’s leadership in the world. We must ensure future generations have all the tools they need to succeed.

[In Congress, I’ll fight to do exactly that. But first, I want to hear your thoughts: What issues impacting public education are most important to you?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/71106708/431174188/215316099?source=RC_EM_PT_WL_231006_1_1&refcode2=951e8497-6c64-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&contactdata=mAZCzH2kVRf0T1vPAyyTEHm7N6OlQaewYSoJ50qcjUzyq6BHirHDqXgRrTJuIpRH&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85ODExOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NTFlODQ5Ny02YzY0LWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qHNs_uZ-zfUWQ-H7Wrvlvw_-OAm0XFCEkaW5yIYnWQo=&emci=29368a7a-6664-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&emdi=951e8497-6c64-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&ceid=24669367) | | **[TAKE THE SURVEY](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/71106709/431174189/215316099?source=RC_EM_PT_WL_231006_1_1&refcode2=951e8497-6c64-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&contactdata=mAZCzH2kVRf0T1vPAyyTEHm7N6OlQaewYSoJ50qcjUzyq6BHirHDqXgRrTJuIpRH&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85ODExOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NTFlODQ5Ny02YzY0LWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qHNs_uZ-zfUWQ-H7Wrvlvw_-OAm0XFCEkaW5yIYnWQo=&emci=29368a7a-6664-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&emdi=951e8497-6c64-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&ceid=24669367)**

clean_body: | “We all cherish our children's future.” JFK “Teaching Facts is NOT Indoctrination” Anonymous JFK 's timeless words inspire us. As do the words and deeds of the good people of Central PA who are standing up for ALL our children's future. We believe that every child in America should have the opportunity to benefit from a high-quality public education. We believe a high-quality public education teaches all students the fundamentals of reading, writing, math, and science as a strong foundation. We believe that a high-quality public education does NOT limit which books our children read and which ideas they explore. We believe that high-quality public education is the spark that ignites every student's thirst for knowledge, understanding, innovation, and determination to learn to work in diverse teams that will define the strength of America for generations to come. Last night’s Inspirational ‘Love to Light the Night Rally’ at Temple Beth Shalom in Mechanicsburg brilliantly communicated all the above. It was an honor to stand amongst all those very good people. Meanwhile, there is an alarming trend sweeping our nation: right-wing extremism pushing its dangerous agenda in our public schools. Whether it’s draconian book bans, whitewashing curriculum, invalidating and endangering LGBTQ+ students, and more, extremists are intent on waging their culture war everywhere they can. It seems Republicans like Scott Perry only want to keep politics out of schools when it goes against their narrow-minded, regressive views. Even beyond the dangerous extremism taking hold, public education still faces underfunding across the country. I believe that high-quality public education is essential to our democracy and to America’s leadership in the world. We must ensure future generations have all the tools they need to succeed. | | Thanks for weighing in on this important issue. \- Rick | | | | | | ---|---|--- Paid for by Friends of Rick Coplen | =

Peter, I know firsthand just how hard our public school educators here in North Carolina work for our kids. My mom was a teacher in NC public schools. I had the benefit of education in our public schools as did my children. I know that students can receive an excellent education with the help of dedicated teachers. **But our teachers aren’t getting the paychecks they deserve, Peter.** Over and over, I’ve prioritized teacher pay in budget proposals. Although Republican legislators have provided some raises, their investment falls far short of where we need to be to attract and retain qualified educators. They are worth so much more. **[I’m once again urging the GOP-controlled legislature to give our public school teachers a better raise. It’s not much of a secret that the Left doesn’t like me very much.
---
But I think the one thing that bothers the Left the most is that they cannot break me.
---
Even after illegal indictments, arrests, impeachments, a mugshot, lawsuits, a threat of 1,000 years in prison, attempting to frame me as a traitor, a sham trial, and more trials to come, _my spirits are honestly higher than ever before._
---
The Left _wants_ to crush our hope and break our spirit. They want to rob us of our joy.
---
_But we can never let them!_
---
The truth is: hope costs you _nothing._
---
Your faith is the one thing **_no one_** can _ever_ take from you.
---
That’s why you will never see me cower. I will never blink in the face of the Left’s tyranny. _I will always stand tall and remain resolute in our mission to save America._
---
We all know America is in a very dark place – and that’s putting it nicely. It would be very easy to say that our country is doomed and all hope is lost.
---
But I will NEVER give up on America!
---
America is the greatest country in history – and I believe it’s our hardworking, innovative, compassionate, and courageous PEOPLE that make it great.
---
And on November 5, 2024, I have faith that the great American patriots who are the backbone of our country will band together to SAVE AMERICA once and for all
---
So, my question to you is: **do**** _YOU_****have faith that America can be saved?**

[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/71114671/431185441/-1986725773?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1323-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkVNUi8xLzgxMzIxIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImNlM2U0YzhmLTczNjQtZWUxMS05OTM3LTAwMjI0ODMyZWI3MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=TIg1WFvDmPXRXmL0WFwjiTvCMInRkjAMXxYC1IXVxwg=)

**Councilmember Serena Gonzales-Gutierrez** (Emerge CO) was born and raised in Denver, Colorado. Having known the pain of displacement, she has dedicated her career to helping Colorado families through affordable housing, strong tenant protections, and major investments in behavioral health.
**Representative Sharlett Mena** (Emerge WA) is a first-generation Mexican American, who brings her experience as a community organizer to the fight for environmental justice, climate action, and policies that lift up Washington’s working families.
When we equip Latinas with the training and network they need to win, we can change the face of politics and ensure ALL our communities are seen, heard, and served at every level of our government. That’s why it’s so crucial to continue our work to achieve a truly inclusive government for the FIRST time in U.S. history! But we can’t do it without you, Peter.

name: Lizzie Pannill Fletcher
subject: What a Week
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS
body:
ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie-reelect-logo-outlined.png]
It’s been another week of confusion and chaos in Congress — this one, historic. It was confusion and chaos that was built into the rules of the House this year by the new Republican Majority. This January, House Republicans adopted new rules to govern the business of the House, rules that every single House Democrat voted against. Among them was a rule that gave any one member of the Republican conference the right to bring a motion to remove the Speaker of the House. And this week, one of them used it.

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe231006?refcode=lpfe231006_active [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe231006?refcode=lpfe231006_active]
This threat has hung over former Speaker McCarthy all year. And it meant that, to keep his position, Speaker McCarthy catered to extreme members of his party on all kinds of unreasonable demands — including demands that he refuse to work with House Democrats and instead advance a divisive, extreme, deeply partisan agenda.
It doesn’t have to be this way. I’ve been saying this over and over this year. And I know it’s true because it wasn’t this way in my two prior terms when Democrats controlled the House. We did not have this rule that allowed any one member to call a vote of no confidence on the Speaker of the House. But, more important, we didn’t govern — or fail to govern — like this.
We were focused on governing responsibility, meeting the needs of the American people in unprecedented times, protecting our democracy, and working across the aisle whenever we could. We didn’t engage in brinkmanship over the debt ceiling or threaten to shut down the government. We did pass some important bills with only Democratic votes, but we welcomed bipartisan support where we could get it. When you hear President Biden and House Democrats talk about our accomplishments from the last two years in particular, so many of the titles start with the word bipartisan.
As Leader Jeffries explained this week, since the beginning of this Congress House Democrats have made it clear that we will find common ground with our Republican colleagues wherever possible and at the same time we will combat extremism whenever necessary. House Democrats compromised with Republicans to avert a catastrophic default on our national debt that would have crashed the economy. Rather than celebrate this major achievement, House Republicans threatened the Speaker over it, and backed out of the agreement they had negotiated after it became law. And then they started talking about shutting down the government unless they got extreme policy passed into law.
So, where do we go from here? Republicans must nominate a new Speaker. At this time, some hardline members of their party have emerged as potential successors. For the sake of our country, I hope House Republicans will pick a different path forward. I hope they will reject the extreme partisanship that got us here in the first place. And I, like my colleagues in the House Democratic Caucus, will be there to work together in a bipartisan way for the good of our country.
I’ll also be working to make sure that the next Congress does not work this way. We do that by electing a Democratic majority and electing Hakeem Jeffries our next Speaker of the House. It is as clear to me as ever, after this historic week, that our work together to make this happen is essential.
Together, we can do anything,

name: Dawn Moore
subject: Service will save us
body:
Friend,

If there is one thing Wes and I strongly believe, it’s that service will save us.

Our commitment to service led us to the Governor’s office in the first place, and it’s why we’ve launched a whole new service-based program for our youth – the first of its kind in the nation!

Let me tell you a little more about it, Firstname: As of this year, Maryland high school graduates had the option to apply for a service year, where they can give back to their communities and earn a living wage for their work. We’re working with local non-profits, businesses, public agencies, and schools to help recent high school graduates kickstart their careers in public service — and over 500 graduates have already applied!
This program is a really big deal. By investing in our youth, we’re investing in a whole new generation for our future. Service is what will bring us together — and we can’t stop here.

For Maryland to continue leading the way and launch more first-in-the-nation programs, Wes needs our support. Today, I’m asking if you’ll support the Moore-Miller administration by making a contribution right now. Any support will go a long way. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20231006-1?refcode=em20231006-1]

Contribute » [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20231006-1?refcode=em20231006-1]

Thank you for believing in us,
Dawn Flythe Moore

# **A Message from the Chairwoman**

| |
# _Support Our Candidates by Voting Early_
---
Team, October is upon us. This means we are just over one month away from electing leadership for our municipalities across the state. From Crown Point to Fort Wayne to Indianapolis down to Evansville, over to Madison, and in between, we are working hard these final 30 days to elect strong Republican leadership in our cities and towns. To make election night as successful as possible, we need your help! If you haven't already, please sign up to help a candidate or the Republican slate near you. body:
ICYMI
| | | |
---
| Maria's Community Champions
---
| |
---|---
Earning the confidence and support of community members, leaders, and business people is what distinguishes Maria Montero--she reflects the people, values, and work ethic of the 7th Congressional District.

This week, we are pleased to share the support of long-time Monroe County Constable, process server, and Republican Party leader, Rick Porvaznik. Rick, originally from Lansford in Carbon County, is a dynamic and trusted leader in Monroe. Growing up in the family business, Porvaznik's Flowers, Rick learned the value of hard work and empowering small businesses. He's supporting Maria because she has the right qualifications for Congress. "Maria is the only candidate who really understands and reflects the values of the people of the 7th District. She grew up here, works here, volunteers here, and is a Conservative who will win back the 7th. She's a natural and dynamic leader whose clear ability to communicate will help us grow our party."
---
| Around the District
---
|
---
|
---
| Easton's Porch Fest in College Hill drew the community together for wonderful music, food, and camaraderie.
---
|
---
|
---
Enjoying this amazing journey and collaborating with supporters at the PA GOP State Committee Meeting.
---
|
---
---
Beautiful evening at the Stroudsmoor with a dynamic slate of candidates for Monroe County with special guest PA Senate Candidate Dave McCormick. Plus, I was able to meet a future candidate for President of the United States :)

As a nation of immigrants, I am so blessed to be American and to celebrate Columbus Day with immense pride for my Italian heritage! Here's to my favorite Italian American, my grandfather Arthur Cardamone.

Fellow Conservative,

I wanted to share a part of my life with you that I hold dear and that has shaped me into who I am today.

**You might not know this, but I'm a proud U.S. Army veteran who served in the 82nd Airborne Division during the First Gulf War.**

[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=e92b7bcc032e4ebaa00e582d1cafcfbf&_e=DWlD4ImZ8nib_xAyrumfO7rM-2qqarCOsqw1aW0lQBHOQRjC_DaM3wrs11DZPKzlpFzd3GvB_ZhzlZaxEqgErtaGBLR00eTF-TvbwXXu92-P0B_UoS4UEZAzt4zlZ_QvmNuuZJy_XSkjzm8Ymyyla40H8XluHyYgLOz9v_q8an-_nMMp6XUOMSquIsnzmiMuMBpLP96yUxCcHO6vSJTeUAXJu8RBSGai2WKUgDntYCl50s6gQKngEf_ku3xbl_63XKCSb4itThh6BKGJGPmg148LhVfUEEWqZ9xWWTOjaU41nOfhxHFiFGJe__dEWoApku3zAolw84d2nLVZw5z2uq_PhytpOoEAsGG8E5vqqQPDClWYTcEUPxGa6KDjrRuS)

**Those years of service are at the core of my values and principles, and they've had a profound impact on my journey.**

My military experience taught me some of life's most important lessons - leading by example, clear and honest communication, owning up to my mistakes, and the ability to adapt and learn from them.

These lessons have been the _foundation of my life,_ guiding me forward in everything I've done since then.

**Today, I'm ready to serve again, but in a different capacity. I'm ready to fight for our great Commonwealth of Pennsylvania in the U.S. Senate.**
[Join My Fight for Pennsylvania](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=e92b7bcc032e4ebaa00e582d1cafcfbf&_e=DWlD4ImZ8nib_xAyrumfO7rM-2qqarCOsqw1aW0lQBHOQRjC_DaM3wrs11DZPKzlpFzd3GvB_ZhzlZaxEqgErtaGBLR00eTF-TvbwXXu92-P0B_UoS4UEZAzt4zlZ_QvmNuuZJy_XSkjzm8Ymyyla40H8XluHyYgLOz9v_q8an-_nMMp6XUOMSquIsnzmiMuMBpLP96yUxCcHO6vSJTeUNgDm4M5sin-eEJmmAQx0k2xlEuHRznJGjd1pmd7TeeTvoPZiTEB-x13Lx1CX635KtdIAvhuKC_rgwr3gwCnwB-WdB0pSjBJ8O83BeL_sI79FqU20oyar-bF5WBfeH3o_1Cjp3ad-ZBbaHlj_SDftK_bK7QsMpzaobhHGIjfUSmM)
---

**[Fellow Conservative, I'm reaching out to you today with a humble request. I'm asking for your support.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=e92b7bcc032e4ebaa00e582d1cafcfbf&_e=DWlD4ImZ8nib_xAyrumfO7rM-2qqarCOsqw1aW0lQBHOQRjC_DaM3wrs11DZPKzlpFzd3GvB_ZhzlZaxEqgErtaGBLR00eTF-TvbwXXu92-P0B_UoS4UEZAzt4zlZ_QvmNuuZJy_XSkjzm8Ymyyla40H8XluHyYgLOz9v_q8an-_nMMp6XUOMSquIsnzmiMuMBpLP96yUxCcHO6vSJTeUK8S7CSme7s_XDdj_HLDJexhU_btM3IX46nRYwanxQA_8miPbCQuKtlYF5w8nguuiuswLXPYK4ydVpy9PHDVBwxT_X2-g7zTh_Bx6gun-50jCrrKBTjqcTm9Ar88DQb2T78Gkq3OLTrutWjkSED1VT-Q6mjb-SL_W2lKGFWXP2DJ)** Pennsylvania needs a battle-tested fighter to win the fight for its future. This election is too critical for any of us to stand on the sidelines - we all have a role to play.

By joining my campaign, **[you'll be contributing to a movement that aims to make a real difference in Pennsylvania's future.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=e92b7bcc032e4ebaa00e582d1cafcfbf&_e=DWlD4ImZ8nib_xAyrumfO7rM-2qqarCOsqw1aW0lQBHOQRjC_DaM3wrs11DZPKzlpFzd3GvB_ZhzlZaxEqgErtaGBLR00eTF-TvbwXXu92-P0B_UoS4UEZAzt4zlZ_QvmNuuZJy_XSkjzm8Ymyyla40H8XluHyYgLOz9v_q8an-_nMMp6XUOMSquIsnzmiMuMBpLP96yUxCcHO6vSJTeUF6fV_Svl4dQRUbf8v4fuw_SB6qSJw30U8Fz3ModIQBPnJKIwUUU9MsY7o9QFUdScOa05RZ8ZCc6fgDlvSQz82UE2H3vM4DAqd-OuhyzxmZ87D8ou-__tYx2F4QudEN_w9iJaiWJcV8p4FUlFvq_B-h7f4YxMVZbT6RqfDWW4qRr)** Your support, in whatever way you can provide it, will be invaluable.

With deep appreciation,

Dave McCormick

| | Peter,

The House Speaker, Republican Kevin McCarthy, was removed from office for the first time in American history. Let’s be honest — **the House is in disarray, and our democracy is in jeopardy.**

While Democrats are willing to take unprecedented steps to accomplish meaningful work, Republicans are preoccupied with blaming Democrats and fueling their money machine by holding the American people hostage. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/71118773/431198989/1416948857?refcode=AU_VAH_EG_LAU_PET_AC_20231006_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDQxOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNjUwODdlOC03ZTY0LWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=j-JX18RwLpDbds3G-iWeKDmB3yj1qDW6VSnaXVqOYp0=&emci=452d1789-6f64-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&emdi=f65087e8-7e64-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&ceid=9636579) Peter, I made the difficult decision to vote out the Speaker because I am committed to preserving our democracy. Friend How do you know when an Empire is collapsing? All empires eventually implode from their own dead weight. The United States was created in a revolutionary rejection of the principle of empire, in favor of a new conception of self-government based on the principle of the General Welfare. Thanks to decades of insane policies following the decoupling of the U.S. Dollar from the gold reserve system, not the least being the trillions of dollars of bailouts given to financial institutions which actually have no intrinsic value since 2008, the banking system is now in a process of self-cannibalization -- looting the American people through inflation, interest rates, property taxes, parking tickets and more. The corruption of the system fosters corruption on every level, and there is an epidemic in the State of New York of homeowners being robbed of their property by local treasurers who never informed them of back taxes owed, or other issues. My two guests, Rich Purtell and Attorney Mark Moody have been fighting the monster, and will share the horror stories from their neighbors who are fighting to get their property back. This will sound familiar to those of you who watched the Symposium about Maui, and those of you who are suffering repeated preventable flooding in Woodside and elsewhere.
### [NY Symposium, Friday, October 6, 8:00 pm: Stop the Great Property Heist! >From Maui to New York, Citizens Are Being Robbed of Their Homes](https://www.sareforsenate.com/r?u=jalJvum2JQxpPvfjGmN5k2TOvE_Fn0JtT-p2Cr7900Y&e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20231006_symposium&n=2)

clean_body: A government shutdown won’t be good for anyone and shouldn’t be used as a bargaining chip. | | | | Rick is working hard to get our priorities to the forefront of the discussion about the government funding bill — but the handful of extreme Republicans proposing devastating cuts to essential social safety nets would rather treat them like bargaining chips than what they are: critical lifelines. That is simply unacceptable. Here's a snippet: "Larsen said Republicans in the House are proposing "draconian cuts" that would have big impacts on lives. For example, House Republicans wanted to cut $14.7 billion from Title I, a program that provides funding for low-income schools. "Those bills will reflect some very serious cuts in important services," he said. "So we can't really tolerate what they propose right now." Larsen's priorities are to maintain these safety net services. He also wants to maintain the levels of investment in transportation infrastructure. "It's one reason why we have such a low unemployment rate, because women and men are working in building the next generation of our infrastructure," he said. Larsen called the Republicans leading the cuts the "chaos caucus." "In my view, they are a fractured caucus, unable to lead and that is bad for the institution of Congress," Larsen said. "I'm the strongest supporter for Ukraine aid," he said. "We will get more aid to Ukraine to push back the illegal invasion of Russia." Earlier this week, Kevin McCarthy became the first speaker of the House in our nation's history to be ousted from the seat | | Peter,

Earlier this week, Kevin McCarthy became the first speaker of the House in our nation's history to be ousted from the seat. House Democrats acted decisively to vote out a leader who abandoned his values and caved to extremists who dishonor our democracy.

As a trauma surgeon, I teach my trainees that every second counts during a crisis to take action and save lives. As an Air Force veteran who values our democracy, I am disappointed that **Kevin McCarthy spent his _short_ time as speaker dividing our nation and pointing blame everywhere _except_ at his party’s bad policies for the suffering of the American people. **He had the opportunity to create positive change and uplift our communities safer — and he failed.

One thing is clear: **We need bold leaders in Congress with the courage to stand up to powerful interests in Washington to save lives; not imperiling our livelihood playing political games.**

My campaign is about taking action. The gun violence epidemic, the unjust American healthcare system, reproductive freedom, the climate crisis, protecting our democracy; these issues demand relentless attention — and I’m answering the call to serve.

**Together, we can make history and create life-saving change. It's Voter Education Week, Peter!

Remember, your vote is your voice, **and it matters.**

With all that's happening on Capitol Hill — _from the looming threat of a government shutdown to the House Speaker debacle_ — it's clear that now, more than ever, we need leaders like Derek who prioritize people over politics.

Voter Education Week is the perfect opportunity to empower yourself and others with the knowledge and tools needed to make informed decisions at the polls. Voting is not just a right; it's a responsibility that empowers us to shape our communities, our state, and our nation. **Voter Education Week is all about ensuring that every eligible citizen is informed, engaged, and ready to exercise their right to vote!**

That's why Derek is proud to have received national recognition for safeguarding the right to vote and upholding our democracy's core principles. He's co-sponsored crucial bills like the John Lewis Voting Rights Act, the Expanding the VOTE Act, the Freedom to Vote Act, and the Protecting our Democracy Act.

Peter, it's no secret that there's a lot on the line in 2024, from our economy, reproductive rights, our environment, voting rights, and so much more, but it's on all of us to stay informed and make our voices heard at the polls. The path forward is never easy, but Derek knows that, together, we have what it takes to move our nation forward. **Our democracy depends on engaged and informed citizens like you.**

I’m speaking out against the Biden administration’s recent decision to admit Israel into the U.S. Visa Waiver Program. | | | [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/ZsYp6Jc2ATNP3MkVzvte6Pmk0F4jS6NOytihmYTOZ1f-yWw6Cj7G9e1dlkX4TL0NMWtZ9DST5cFtdsPS-4D2fKNVbxdzSbLD9T9x2URiTkAkvV0OpQQCoNHFnrXrpjTvEKXrAQW0T9Domm0NrtGLai6paPXvLNFE_typrjzNq5tx3zSDPF2mvVCJjA4bbhsmRZX6s2hKLeV9KXIMl5T-Eq4EM20M6iFX7oLVj6mov1JvFfVyL_koo4mmsCWm6TSjkdjBFsUEkAyCubMT_YeZAPYqORxjzh8cxSBvAzeI_NzyjCWevcvlzUtZia5x3T-hp8AmzCAGA3ag8uwQjSk1rPTmcXOnRL-wZShtFwlL-dh9RwiIH9KiMsBZ6XkQagXB/407/r2I4xYHrTLelKy2aWQQ3Uw/h0/EVOM_vv231Po2lJN2IgffipQiM4v-d1BkhC3GMv9z2E)
---
Friend, The Biden administration just admitted Israel into the U.S. Visa Waiver Program. **The Visa Waiver Program requires that all U.S. citizens are treated equally, but the far-right Israeli government routinely mistreats and detains American citizens at its points of entry, discriminating against** Palestinian, Middle Eastern, North African, Muslim, and pro-Palestinian Americans. After hearing the news about the Visa Waiver Program, American journalist Yumna Patel tweeted: _“I found out about this news as I, an American citizen, sit in a waiting room at the Israeli border after being interrogated on my pregnancy status, and harassed & threatened after I complained about the prying questions.”_ I led a congressional letter to Secretary of State Antony Blinken and Secretary of Homeland Security Alejandro Mayorkas, arguing that this disparate treatment at Israel’s points of entry make it ineligible for inclusion in the Visa Waiver Program. [**As the only Palestinian American in Congress, I will continue to fight against all forms of discrimination—including disparate treatment based on ethnicity, national origin, or faith. | | **A Note from CAPT Hung Cao USN (Ret)** We’ve had a busy few weeks on the campaign trail over the last month as I’ve been traveling across the state meeting with voters in Arlington County, Virginia Beach, and Harrisonburg who are concerned about the direction our country is heading in. Based on conversations I’ve had with voters, it’s clear to me that Virginians are ready to elect a fighter to the U.S. Senate. While the momentum for our campaign continues to grow, I am grateful for every supporter and voter who is ready to retire Tim Kaine. After serving our country for 25 years, I know there’s more to be done and I look forward to continuing to serve every American and every Virginian when I am elected in 2024. \- CAPT Hung Cao USN (Ret)

| | | [ ](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/r?u=psQUkJGc26u6Wi0imicX-00jZnUVaZYVu06OFU-xtOc&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20231006all_bidenborderwall&n=1)

Dear Peter, The Derelict Duopoly knows no bounds when it comes to subjugating poor, working-class, and vulnerable people to intersecting calamities. President Biden’s announcement that he will continue building Donald Trump’s border wall is irrefutable proof that both ruling parties are on the same team, working against the people. This is yet another Biden promise broken — a promise he made to the people of the United States while campaigning not to build "another foot of the wall."
---
**Dr. West is running as an Independent precisely to challenge the policies of the ruling parties.[Will you make a contribution to our campaign so we can dispatch the duopoly of Democrats and Republicans and their mutually complicit authoritarianism?](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/donate?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20231006all_bidenborderwall&n=2)** Biden ordered his administration to waive 26 federal laws, including bedrock environmental laws like NEPA, the Endangered Species Act, the Clean Air Act, and the Clean Water Act, to expedite the construction of a 20-foot wall of hate that will act as nothing more than a symbol of white supremacist nationalism that continues to metastasize across the country and the world. This president and the duopoly as a whole prefer rolling back laws to construct walls and pipelines rather than using the law to establish pathways to safety and dignity for migrants, people, and the planet. It has to stop, and it will, when Dr. West becomes President of the United States and serves the people with an independent voice rooted in pillars of truth, justice, and love.
---
With solidarity, **Dr. Cornel West**

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: To me, policy is personal.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
Did you know that over half of all Members of Congress are millionaires? Meanwhile, the median household income is only $70,784. 👈🏽 **This is wild.**
Many of our lawmakers have no lived experience of working paycheck to paycheck or trying to pay rent working a low-wage job.
To me, policy is personal. When I worked as a bartender, I relied on tips to pay the bills. I know the urgent and daily stresses of working class people because I have lived them. And I intimately understand how important measures like raising the minimum wage, universal health care, universal child care, and free college can be for families living in financial uncertainty.
That’s why I’m in Congress: **to represent working families like mine.**
I am honored to be here, and I can’t do this work without you — the grassroots supporters who have had my back every step of the way. I can’t self-fund my campaign by writing a big check, and I don’t do any donor call-time or exclusive fundraising events.
[We rely completely on small-dollar donors, so if you are able, can you chip in $5 today to our campaign for progress?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20231006.fpBpG6&refcode=em20231006-5106-P_FND_RES_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5106%2E2526796%2EafyxA3)
****
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20231006.fpBpG6&refcode=em20231006-5106-P_FND_RES_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=5106%2E2526796%2EafyxA3)**
Yours in service,
Alexandria

For the first time in a long time, a politician was held accountable for breaking their promise to the American people.
Everyone knows Washington is broken, and lots of Republicans talk about how dysfunctional it is, but _**nobody ever does anything about it!**_
**That all changed when I stood up to the entire Swamp and removed Kevin McCarthy as Speaker.**
We’re not going to save this country from being destroyed if we keep doing business as usual. It’s going to take courage and decisive action to eradicate the culture of failure and decline that rots our Congress to its core.
Of course, the lobbyists and special interests who control the politicians in Washington want Congress to work just the way it does: FOR THEM!
**I want Congress to work the way the Founders intended: FOR YOU!**
Americans didn’t give Republicans the majority in the House to keep funding the Biden Pelosi agenda, they elected us to stop the insanity and get our country working for the people again.
**The RINOs in the Republican party are FURIOUS at me for exposing the fact they are bought and paid for by the Swamp, and now they’re plotting to EXPEL me from Congress.**
| [ **SAVE GAETZ** ](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=5b47fa8e27b441a285d2e7f5c3e92353&_e=bMbwq2emWLX8lqXkdtBRDMRhoEp3JTKZ6JgcRY70jeztTtu2n7C0B2pOmXkY40GYPSQjVkR6LTE9NUiFGpnXy01t8OM8R_7uDbdDreG2d9fW1Dku068d7nrHWveu1d1svK5VMkfb2MZvSKzVWWkx-Vt24Qb9jTarvVz7elTiGFaWvOmi4wIyr4YVjumGWTl0G6diKLG2h8NUqLYpbdq5cAsNDBPJSbgeHu6QMYKwX5OM5YvBhX-DJNXxcCfDTVMplQ_jBbT5KKXp1QClSxckC_ai6hYH9bXFgMC_Gdms2kW8O5uCxXB-byKpAUgl-mmvTIlyaTnmLLz1TKICye28je2R6-qM_AsE10OLHHTGrYg%3D)

**[We’re finally on the verge of ushering in REAL CHANGE to how Washington works, and I’m asking you to stand with me in this seminal moment.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=5b47fa8e27b441a285d2e7f5c3e92353&_e=bMbwq2emWLX8lqXkdtBRDMRhoEp3JTKZ6JgcRY70jeztTtu2n7C0B2pOmXkY40GYPSQjVkR6LTE9NUiFGpnXy01t8OM8R_7uDbdDreG2d9fW1Dku068d7nrHWveu1d1svK5VMkfb2MZvSKzVWWkx-Vt24Qb9jTarvVz7elTiGFaWvOmi4wIyr4YVjumGWTl0G6diKLG2h8NUqLYpbdq5cJ2kdJbsj2WUfl0ofZUisXpgvjWolheBrCotf_B5jA3KSTJGQQYdSrLN5pYBUVuwvssBXivZhwfrk4-M5rdrTrlu4_bQmA18BGBAkDbuxXbgNcNnE6sFb1ohqNGAVhfqcllW2pRFVyBFSiCwkB8NOyc%3D)**
If the Swamp expels me for taking a stand, it won’t happen again for a generation. Nothing will change, and our country will be doomed.
I’ve been humbled by the outpouring of support, and I’ll never apologize for funding my political operation exclusively from patriots that share my determination. Thanks for standing strong, Matt Gaetz

name: Friends of the Earth
subject: Sign The Petition: Save Florida’s manatees from extinction
body:
| | | | | [](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2037213?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---|---|---

| | **URGENT ACTION NEEDED: Help save Florida’s manatees from the greedy Big Cruise industry before it’s too late.[_Take action now >>_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2037214?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) ** When you think of manatees, you likely picture chubby gray creatures slowly and peacefully floating along the Gulf Coast waters, seemingly without a care in the world. Affectionately referred to as “sea cows”, these gentle giants are one of the most beloved marine animals — known for their harmless, friendly demeanor and round chunky bodies. It’s hard to imagine these iconic creatures underweight, _**fragile and weak with their bones protruding through their skin**_. But sadly, that’s exactly what’s happening to Florida’s manatees right now because they are struggling to find seagrass to feed on. Without enough vital nutrients to keep them nourished, manatees are **_STARVING TO DEATH._** And with so little fat to remain afloat, these helpless animals are even _**DROWNING**_ _**TO DEATH,**_ too. **Manatees cannot survive without seagrass as their main food source** — and **_cruise ship pollution_** is contributing to the decimation of this essential plant. For years, the greedy cruise industry has been contaminating the sensitive Florida waters with harmful toxic pollutants which can lead to disruption of manatee habitats, causing irreparable damage to seagrass beds. [**_We cannot let Big Cruise continue pushing manatees closer to _EXTINCTION_ all for the sake of corporate profit. These precious animals are depending on us to be their voice, Friend, so please ACT NOW to help SAVE Florida’s manatees before it’s too late >>_**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2037215?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2037216?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
The data is staggering and alarming, Friend. We’ve already lost _**25% of the entire manatee population**_ in the past TWO YEARS alone, totaling nearly **_2,000 manatee deaths._**
And manatees aren’t the only ones who depend on seagrass. This important plant stores almost **_1⁄5 of the whole world’s ocean carbon_** , playing a key role in our ecosystems by promoting healthy coastal communities and combating the impacts of climate change.
**_But Big Cruise is more concerned with their bottom line than the fate of vulnerable manatees or the future of our oceans_**. In order to maximize profits, cruise companies are increasing ship traffic, size, and volume, all while carelessly dumping TOXIC wastewater and other HARMFUL contaminants, **compromising Florida’s water quality and damaging fragile marine habitats.**
That’s why we’re urgently calling on the Environmental Protection Agency to take action and STOP Big Cruise’s dangerous ocean pollution. But if we’re going to apply enough public pressure to have a meaningful impact, we need you to be **one of 1,406 activists** who will speak up before our critical **_DEADLINE at 11:59 P.M. tonight_.** [_**Can we count on you to take action right away to protect manatees and our oceans from the cruise industry’s corporate greed? Add your name now >>**_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2037217?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
[SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2037218?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
**Your voice is critical to protecting manatees and our oceans,
Friends of the Earth**

body:
Today’s GOP cannot be trusted to govern in the best interests of the American people.
#

Hey, it’s Alex. Like you, I’ve been watching the chaos unfolding in the House of Representatives. And here’s the conclusion I’ve come to:
**Today’s GOP cannot be trusted to govern in the best interests of the American people.**
We’re talking about a political party in which several members have seriously suggested that they’d support _Donald Trump_ — who encouraged a violent mob to storm the Capitol — to serve as Speaker of the House.
All this at a time in which they _should_ be focusing on the fact that there’s another government shutdown looming in just over a month. We’re seeing what happens when Republicans are in charge, and it’s clear that the American people deserve better than this.
That’s why, as Vice-Chair of the DSCC, I’m working hard to support my colleagues in key races across the country so we can hold onto our Democratic majority in the Senate.
Because while Republicans are locked in infighting and disarray, Democrats are united in our commitment to deliver results for the American people.
But in order to do that, and really make progress on the problems facing our country, we’ve got to hold onto our majority and keep the GOP out of power.
It’s not going to be easy — we’re defending almost twice as many seats as the GOP, including in states like Ohio and Montana that voted for Donald Trump. But I know that as long as enough people like you step up and get involved, and we all do our part, then we can accomplish anything together.
[**Will you please make a contribution to help hold the Senate majority for Democrats? We can’t afford to let the GOP take control and bring the same infighting and chaos from the House to the Senate.](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-october23.aQx2ke&refcode=em231006-1-30&t=1&akid=1559%2E159979%2E-r6S7U)**

And here’s the conclusion I’ve come to: Today’s GOP cannot be trusted to govern in the best interests of the American people. We’re talking about a political party in which several members have seriously suggested that they’d support Donald Trump — who encouraged a violent mob to storm the Capitol — to serve as Speaker of the House. All this at a time in which they should be focusing on the fact that there’s another government shutdown looming in just over a month. We’re seeing what happens when Republicans are in charge, and it’s clear that the American people deserve better than this. That’s why, as Vice-Chair of the DSCC, I’m working hard to support my colleagues in key races across the country so we can hold onto our Democratic majority in the Senate. Because while Republicans are locked in infighting and disarray, Democrats are united in our commitment to deliver results for the American people. But in order to do that, and really make progress on the problems facing our country, we’ve got to hold onto our majority and keep the GOP out of power. It’s not going to be easy — we’re defending almost twice as many seats as the GOP, including in states like Ohio and Montana that voted for Donald Trump. subject: What's My story.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Wendy Davis for Congress
body:
| [ ](http://links.davisforin.com/u/click?_t=3e9e6097e33749f890adf7e8c9b24a4e&_m=9c1b9947d88546e985624a11cca9944a&_e=1PikzkR-NcpFhxELQ8uERIt86d8e0XKwY36dNQSRGhU5uLASU125FOY0-y4BvUq-c-9XbL-BsBunZc46X3Y2sCV-aglTkAWHpPgFaK4A6I6nh6x6SHztLFQhl3VbnaxSl6rkojGJaxhIpcpFGTlBNhYK09yMFP70WM3dfo-49EBNvoda3xkj7y_AC7d4ZNGx6c47ioGinizUFcYwwc7Ty89d4QHs8uhDkRmSqrQ3NTF7eugniJ-Su-IrzndTEpoUA1__YFZz2eaj4bGUEGZxAaxQiROqEXz1hxwC3uIf9N9n0FLJq2eyBQinc2hQHtKe)
---
Hey, I wanted to take a minute and reach out to you to tell my story.

As a contender for one of the most important congressional races in the country -- I think it's important everybody knows exactly where I stand leading into this election.

So -- let's get right to it.

**_Why am I running for Congress?_**
| [**HELP SECURE THE GOP MAJORITY!** ](http://links.davisforin.com/u/click?_t=3e9e6097e33749f890adf7e8c9b24a4e&_m=9c1b9947d88546e985624a11cca9944a&_e=1PikzkR-NcpFhxELQ8uERIt86d8e0XKwY36dNQSRGhU5uLASU125FOY0-y4BvUq-c-9XbL-BsBunZc46X3Y2sCV-aglTkAWHpPgFaK4A6I6nh6x6SHztLFQhl3VbnaxSl6rkojGJaxhIpcpFGTlBNrY0a-_X1k7xVTReXFU6e8xsO4oPRMFdI_h95-Uwsz_4kNdf7yqPyyU--NxARCyF8z24h2e7bFvKiIzp5oR7DBsmTII9ZYdUMnGD_Fup7pHvGXCcEMvH020gNfegQ5L3EOTZW8_-BoDmKevtRiAiXl25yQvpS5CxGmuxa5x5MNe4)
---

Because it's imperative to bring back the strong America we grew up in.

**For over 12 years, I have served as a Judge for the state of Indiana and was the first female Allen Circuit Court Judge.** I took the gravity of my oath seriously, treating every case fairly and refusing to legislate from the bench.

I had a duty to enforce the law as written, but my position gave me a unique perspective to see where the law needs to be changed to improve our community and country. I saw firsthand what change is needed in this nation, and I intend to work every day to bring back the America we grew up in.

**Now, I 'm asking Hoosiers to send me to Congress to restore the American dream.**

**_What 's my Story?_**
My two siblings and I were raised in a home centered around Christ and immersed in the value of hard work.

My father - the hardest worker I have ever met - came from very humble beginnings and worked his own way through college, eventually earning a Ph.D.

My parents raised me to believe in the American dream because our family was living it. Through hard work and dedication, my family prospered. [**Every family living in this great nation deserves the same opportunity.**](http://links.davisforin.com/u/click?_t=3e9e6097e33749f890adf7e8c9b24a4e&_m=9c1b9947d88546e985624a11cca9944a&_e=1PikzkR-NcpFhxELQ8uERIt86d8e0XKwY36dNQSRGhU5uLASU125FOY0-y4BvUq-c-9XbL-BsBunZc46X3Y2sCV-aglTkAWHpPgFaK4A6I6nh6x6SHztLFQhl3VbnaxS2RiY6vF5W8bj23FBDfGdtpZiTyAG-b8xfaDoEwCV_s59y6GZ4D6TadEhF0kZHGe3BPhF9dSTvj5EK2ibDOKKeNBftMEY1FADBHsDYJPwf-f9ATQrs_5vL4TfhsCdqnY3zkez95I8Vq6-T4Wz-dkdFyysmrq3EiE7W97ZEKhkME2y8LsW5_Gpt1oZU8HIFAY9)

[**HELP ME BRING BACK THE AMERICAN DREAM!** ](http://links.davisforin.com/u/click?_t=3e9e6097e33749f890adf7e8c9b24a4e&_m=9c1b9947d88546e985624a11cca9944a&_e=1PikzkR-NcpFhxELQ8uERIt86d8e0XKwY36dNQSRGhU5uLASU125FOY0-y4BvUq-c-9XbL-BsBunZc46X3Y2sCV-aglTkAWHpPgFaK4A6I6nh6x6SHztLFQhl3VbnaxSl6rkojGJaxhIpcpFGTlBNt-QRKi6DSfhP3JL5CPEQzojUok83ITa4QWyJabnjvzBJSohD2UGgwwAiKyY5tCRM4vtKpKvJ-iNm1mna7PsF1Bxei1Jt2fu8DmHRs1Vtz_38Z-rxIENqw3Q5kN4ie-JBNmx0yvFhmVrBlY3bS1vAob3Hu6AEpjKRM7nBze1NhkJ)
---

I was instilled with my father's work ethic and determination. A product of Fort Wayne public schools, I went on to attend Wheaton College in Illinois, where I met my future husband, Scott. I continued my education at Valparaiso University School of Law, completing my J.D. at Saint Mary's Law School in San Antonio, Texas when Scott began his active duty in the U.S. Army.

**As the daughter of a U.S. Army Reservist, the wife of a Lieutenant Colonel in the U.S. Air Force - Indiana Air National Guard, and mother of a West Point graduate, I am passionate about ensuring our service members have what they need to keep our country safe, and our veterans are equipped with the resources they need for a successful transition back to civilian life. **

I am committed to making our American military strong once again to protect our freedoms and way of life. **I want to restore America to the strong country I grew up in so we can leave a better America for our kids and for future generations.**

**_How do we bring America BACK?_**
[**HELP ME BRING BACK THE AMERICAN DREAM!** ](http://links.davisforin.com/u/click?_t=3e9e6097e33749f890adf7e8c9b24a4e&_m=9c1b9947d88546e985624a11cca9944a&_e=1PikzkR-NcpFhxELQ8uERIt86d8e0XKwY36dNQSRGhU5uLASU125FOY0-y4BvUq-c-9XbL-BsBunZc46X3Y2sCV-aglTkAWHpPgFaK4A6I6nh6x6SHztLFQhl3VbnaxSl6rkojGJaxhIpcpFGTlBNs7Y5oc0jm_jtOra73ZH0a1LKAH8Su3euw2gkQGB1Xf8EcoF6mGGu_QgC752a24vxA0lL6XJcMO1gQH2cKgN-SV-egLyE_-0OrpusK_g41ItVZ1ZGcSE1BcItKF9fEddzuouMmL4Oa5csZrubvg_gI-qrht1QylAyo0GdoNTXMTx)
---

**This starts with confronting the alarming embrace of a radical, divisive agenda pushed by the Left in our schools, corporations, and institutions.** This "woke" ideology seeks to rewrite American history and undermine the very freedoms our nation was founded upon. I believe that America is the greatest country in the history of the world, and we must teach our children to respect the United States Constitution and the freedoms it affords - the same Constitution I have been upholding every day as a judge.

**I recognize the harm done to Hoosier families by President Biden and the Washington Democrats ' agenda. Our economy is in shambles because of out-of-control liberal spending and inflation.** Biden's negligence has opened our border, and fentanyl is the leading cause of death in working-age Americans as a result.

Rather than just complain and react to these problems as a judge, I am determined to tackle these issues head-on and execute commonsense strategies that will actually help Hoosiers in their daily lives. After fighting fentanyl and illegal immigration in my courtroom for years, I know it is time for me to step out of the judiciary - where I can only react to problems on a case-by-case basis - and proactively take on these nationwide issues I am witnessing in Northeast Indiana.

**In 2015, Governor Pence appointed me to the Governor 's Task Force on Drug Enforcement, Treatment, and Prevention, where I, along with other Indiana state officials and law enforcement, helped to implement statewide solutions to the drug crisis.**

I'm ready to take that experience to Congress and work to improve the lives of Hoosier families across Northeast Indiana. I believe in personal responsibility, small government, and low taxes. I will work to restore our economy and fight against socialist spending policies that hand your hard-earned money over to coastal elites. I will fight against the Left's rejection of truth and ensure that girls' sports are for girls only.

I will be an unabashed voice for the voiceless in Congress and stand for the rights of unborn babies. And I will firmly defend the constitutional rights of all Americans, especially the Second Amendment. [**These are the issues that matter most to me, and you can count on me to deliver.**](http://links.davisforin.com/u/click?_t=3e9e6097e33749f890adf7e8c9b24a4e&_m=9c1b9947d88546e985624a11cca9944a&_e=1PikzkR-NcpFhxELQ8uERIt86d8e0XKwY36dNQSRGhU5uLASU125FOY0-y4BvUq-c-9XbL-BsBunZc46X3Y2sCV-aglTkAWHpPgFaK4A6I6nh6x6SHztLFQhl3VbnaxS2RiY6vF5W8bj23FBDfGdtpZiTyAG-b8xfaDoEwCV_s7znwbwEO49zsGdWBcomvqeDiEArjdO38soeqaXbhoCXd0hyuaZNY0JisFJgyh216p5s3xqI_UPDjoGPo01g_NTAnIyjBeJx8V7X-buXyVb9skhDxUemhWAv3rwy8aQrXXWT92HcoR0-QtRjZn_JMiV)

**_What 's next?_**
Now that you know a bit more about me -- I'd be honored if you could support my run for Congress.

The GOP has one chance to take this country back from the brink of destruction. We have a slim majority in the House, but the U.S. Senate is still in the hands of the radical left.

If we want to enact sweeping changes and restore the conservative values that let my and many other American families prosper -- we need a HUGE red wave in 2024.

It's only with your support that we can make this happen.

**_Is there ANYTHING you can spare to help us SECURE our House Majority and TAKE BACK AMERICA?_**
